// שום חישוב לפני שהמלבן בתצוגה; ב-C5 — זרוע המילוי של המכלית (לפי מצב), נורות אדומות בלילה; ב-D5 — אוטובוס 45 יוצא לשטיפה וחוזר (אחד מ-48, הצייר האחד של העיר),
// מכונת השטיפה עובדת רק כשיש אוטובוס; המחסום סגור (אין אוטובוס שיוצא מהחניון כשהקווים מושהים) — הנורה שלו בלילה.
(function () {
  var K6 = 6;                                                                                         // 1 מ׳ גובה = 6 פיקס׳ למעלה
  function box(ctx, x, y, w, d, h, top, side) { var H = h * K6; ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.2)'; ctx.fillRect(x + 2, y + 2, w + 3, d + 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = side; ctx.fillRect(x, y + d - H, w, H); ctx.fillStyle = top; ctx.fillRect(x, y - H, w, d); }
  function cyl(ctx, cx, cy, r, h, top, side) {                                                        // מכל גלילי (חוות המכלים)
    var H = h * K6; ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.2)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx + 2, cy + 2, r, r * .5, 0, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = side; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx - r, cy); ctx.lineTo(cx - r, cy - H); ctx.lineTo(cx + r, cy - H); ctx.lineTo(cx + r, cy); ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, r, r * .5, 0, 0, Math.PI); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = top; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, cy - H, r, r * .5, 0, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.25)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, cy - H, r, r * .5, 0, 0, 6.2832); ctx.stroke(); }
  function hatch(ctx, r, col) { ctx.save(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(r[0], r[1], r[2] - r[0], r[3] - r[1]); ctx.clip(); ctx.strokeStyle = col; ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
    for (var k = r[0] - (r[3] - r[1]); k < r[2]; k += 9) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(k, r[3]); ctx.lineTo(k + (r[3] - r[1]), r[1]); ctx.stroke(); } ctx.restore(); }
  function dash(ctx, r, col, w) { ctx.save(); ctx.setLineDash([8, 5]); ctx.strokeStyle = col; ctx.lineWidth = w || 2; ctx.strokeRect(r[0] + 1, r[1] + 1, r[2] - r[0] - 2, r[3] - r[1] - 2); ctx.restore(); }
  function stall(ctx, s, col) { var x = s.x, y = s.y, w = s.w, h = s.h; ctx.strokeStyle = col; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y); ctx.lineTo(x, y + h); ctx.moveTo(x + w, y); ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h); ctx.moveTo(x, y + h); ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h); ctx.stroke(); }
  function text(ctx, t, x, y, fs, col, rot) { ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x, y); if (rot) ctx.rotate(rot); ctx.fillStyle = col; ctx.font = '700 ' + fs + 'px "Segoe UI",Arial'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle'; ctx.direction = 'rtl'; ctx.fillText(t, 0, 0); ctx.restore(); }
  function fence(ctx, segs, col) { ctx.strokeStyle = col || 'rgba(60,64,60,.8)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.beginPath();
    segs.forEach(function (s) { ctx.moveTo(s[0], s[1]); ctx.lineTo(s[2], s[3]); }); ctx.stroke(); }
  function zebra(ctx, x, y, horiz, N) { ctx.fillStyle = N ? 'rgba(220,220,220,.5)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.85)';
    for (var k = -16; k <= 16; k += 6) { if (horiz) ctx.fillRect(x + k, y - 10, 3.5, 20); else ctx.fillRect(x - 10, y + k, 20, 3.5); } }

  var TAU = 6.2832;
  // ---------------- what moves (D‑339): the places — world px (10 px = 1 m; a metre of height = 6 px up) ----------------
  var M5 = {
    flare: { x: 2680, y: 3532, h: 132 },                                                                  // the flare stack, 22 m, the refinery's north-west corner
    chim: [{ id: 'C5-STACK-1', x: 2730, y: 3764, h: 72, smoke: 1 }, { id: 'C5-STACK-2', x: 2820, y: 3764, h: 60, smoke: 0 }],   // on the plant's roof (16 m)
    cool: { x0: 2818, y0: 4040, x1: 2862, y1: 4078, H: 5, fans: [[2829, 4029], [2851, 4029]], basin: [2818, 4080, 2862, 4102] },   // the cooling tower and its basin
    pump: { x0: 2790, y0: 3660, x1: 2812, y1: 3674, wx: 2807, wy: 3651, wr: 6 },                          // the transfer pump between the four tanks, its flywheel
    trFans: [[3430, 3596], [3450, 3596], [3510, 3596], [3530, 3596]],                                     // the transformers' cooling fans (the south face)
    fill: { px: 3003, py: 3972, at: [2945, 3970] },                                                      // the tanker's filling arm: its post at the bay's east edge; the hatch (C5ND.tanker.fill)
    van: { pts: [[2876, 3870], [3018, 3870], [3018, 4062], [2876, 4062]], r: 14, v: 24, stops: [[.17, 5], [.64, 4]], asset: 'VH-PK-01', ref: 'Pickup', c: 0, ph: 23 },
    walk: [{ id: 'C5-W-1', a: 'PE-34', p: [[2925, 3690], [2925, 3856]], v: 12, rest: 4, ph: 0, act: 'סבב בדיקה בין המכלים לעמדת המילוי' },
           { id: 'C5-W-2', a: 'PE-35', p: [[2906, 3916], [2986, 3916]], v: 10, rest: 5, ph: 6, act: 'בדיקת עמדת המילוי והצנרת' },
           { id: 'C5-W-3', a: 'PE-24', p: [[2700, 3996], [2850, 3996]], v: 12, rest: 3, ph: 11, act: 'בדיקה לאורך הקיר הדרומי של המתקן' },
           { id: 'C5-W-4', a: 'PE-39', p: [[3200, 3881], [3318, 3881]], v: 11, rest: 4, ph: 3, act: 'עבודה ברחבת רציפי הטעינה' }]

  var M5D = {
    arm: { x: 3946, y: 4080, L: 52 },                                                                     // the barrier of the depot's gate (from CL-PG): closed — no bus leaves while the lines are paused
    walk: [{ id: 'D5-W-1', a: 'PE-22', p: [[3975, 3946], [4300, 3946]], v: 12, rest: 5, ph: 0, act: 'נהג בודק את האוטובוסים לאורך המעבר' },

  function inV(v, x0, y0, x1, y1) { return !v || (x1 > v[0] && x0 < v[2] && y1 > v[1] && y0 < v[3]); }
  function h01(i, k) { var h = (i * 73856093 ^ k * 19349663) >>> 0; h = Math.imul(h ^ h >>> 15, 2246822507) >>> 0; h = Math.imul(h ^ h >>> 13, 3266489909) >>> 0; return ((h ^ h >>> 16) >>> 0) % 10000 / 10000; }
  // the one wind of the game (tcWind, p507) — the same for the smoke, the steam, the flags and the water; a local copy for the sheets
  function wind0(t) { var a = .18 * Math.sin(t * .031) + .1 * Math.sin(t * .117 + 2), s = .72 + .18 * Math.sin(t * .043 + 1) + .1 * Math.sin(t * .19); return { a: a, s: s, x: Math.cos(a) * s, y: Math.sin(a) * s }; }
  function windAt(t) { return typeof tcWind === 'function' ? tcWind(t) : wind0(t); }
  // the far zoom: fewer particles (1 at zoom ≥ 1, 0.35 at 0.6)
  function lod() { var z = (typeof Camera !== 'undefined' && Camera.zoom) || 1; return z >= 1 ? 1 : z <= .6 ? .35 : .35 + .65 * (z - .6) / .4; }
  // ---- pictures made once: a soft puff (smoke, steam), a glow, the flame in 4 leans × 4 heights ----
  var SPR = {};
  function mkC(w, h) { var c = (typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document : window.document).createElement('canvas'); c.width = w; c.height = h; return c; }
  function puffSpr(col) { var k = 'p' + col; if (SPR[k]) return SPR[k]; var c = mkC(32, 32), g = c.getContext('2d'), gr = g.createRadialGradient(16, 16, 1, 16, 16, 16);
    gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + col + ',1)'); gr.addColorStop(.55, 'rgba(' + col + ',.62)'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + col + ',0)'); g.fillStyle = gr; g.fillRect(0, 0, 32, 32); return SPR[k] = c; }
  function glowSpr(col) { var k = 'g' + col; if (SPR[k]) return SPR[k]; var c = mkC(64, 64), g = c.getContext('2d'), gr = g.createRadialGradient(32, 32, 1, 32, 32, 32);
    gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + col + ',.9)'); gr.addColorStop(.35, 'rgba(' + col + ',.35)'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + col + ',0)'); g.fillStyle = gr; g.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64); return SPR[k] = c; }
  function tongue(ctx, x, y, L, lean, w, col, ph) { var wob = Math.sin(ph) * L * .08, tx = x + lean * L + wob, ty = y - L * (1 - .25 * Math.abs(lean));
    ctx.fillStyle = col; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x - w, y); ctx.bezierCurveTo(x - w * 1.6, y - L * .35, tx - w * .8 - lean * L * .2, ty + L * .35, tx, ty);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(tx + w * .9, ty + L * .4, x + w * 1.7 + lean * L * .15, y - L * .3, x + w, y); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); }
  var LEANS = [.1, .35, .6, .85], FLICK = [.7, .82, .94, 1.06], FSEQ = [0, 2, 1, 3, 2, 0, 3, 1, 2, 3, 0, 1];
  function flameSpr(li, fi) { var k = 'f' + li + '_' + fi; if (SPR[k]) return SPR[k]; var c = mkC(40, 40), g = c.getContext('2d'), lean = LEANS[li], L = 22 * FLICK[fi];
    tongue(g, 14, 38, L, lean, 3.4, 'rgba(255,112,24,.88)', fi * .9); tongue(g, 14, 38, L * .68, lean * .9, 2.4, 'rgba(255,196,64,.95)', 1.7 + fi); tongue(g, 14, 38, L * .32, lean * .7, 1.3, 'rgba(255,248,214,.95)', 3.1 + fi * .5); return SPR[k] = c; }
  // smoke / steam: n puffs that rise, grow, drift with the wind and fade — each source its own rate and phase
  function plume(ctx, x, y, t, W, n, rise, r0, r1, col, a0, rate, seed) { var spr = puffSpr(col), m = Math.max(2, Math.round(n * lod())), ga = ctx.globalAlpha;
    for (var i = 0; i < m; i++) { var u = (t * rate + i / m + seed) % 1, e = u * (2 - u), px = x + W.x * rise * 1.15 * u + Math.sin(t * .8 + i * 2.1 + seed * 7) * 2.5 * u, py = y - rise * e + W.y * rise * .3 * u, r = r0 + r1 * u;
      ctx.globalAlpha = a0 * (1 - u) * Math.min(1, u * 8); ctx.drawImage(spr, px - r, py - r, 2 * r, 2 * r); } ctx.globalAlpha = ga; }
  // the flare's flame: a picture of its lean and its flicker; at night the glow (one picture, lighter)
  function flame(ctx, x, y, t, W, nt) { var lean = W.x * .8, li = Math.max(0, Math.min(3, Math.round((lean - .1) / .25))), fi = FSEQ[Math.floor(t * 12) % 12];
    if (nt > .05) { var op = ctx.globalCompositeOperation, ga = ctx.globalAlpha; ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; ctx.globalAlpha = .55 * nt * (.8 + .2 * FLICK[fi]); ctx.drawImage(glowSpr('255,140,40'), x - 48 + lean * 6, y - 60, 96, 96); ctx.globalAlpha = ga; ctx.globalCompositeOperation = op; }
    ctx.drawImage(flameSpr(li, fi), x - 14, y - 38); }
  // a lamp: the red obstruction lights (at night), the amber beacons; a glow at night
  var COLS = { red: ['255,40,30', '#ff2a1e'], amber: ['255,170,20', '#ffaa14'], green: ['60,220,90', '#3cdc5a'] };
  function light(ctx, x, y, on, nt, c) { var C = COLS[c || 'red'];
    if (on) { if (nt > .05) { var op = ctx.globalCompositeOperation, ga = ctx.globalAlpha; ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; ctx.globalAlpha = .35 + .4 * nt; var r = 6 + 7 * nt; ctx.drawImage(glowSpr(C[0]), x - r, y - r, 2 * r, 2 * r); ctx.globalAlpha = ga; ctx.globalCompositeOperation = op; }
      ctx.fillStyle = C[1]; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, 1.9, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff'; ctx.fillRect(x - .5, y - .5, 1, 1); }
    else { ctx.fillStyle = '#461412'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, 1.5, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); } }
  function blink(t, off, per, on) { per = per || 1.5; on = on || .6; return ((t + off) % per + per) % per < on; }
  // a turning fan / wheel: n blades round (x, y); sy squeezes it (a fan lying on a roof = .5, a wheel facing south = 1)
  function fan(ctx, x, y, r, a, sy, col, n) { n = n || 4; ctx.strokeStyle = col; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.beginPath();
    for (var k = 0; k < n; k++) { var b = a + k * TAU / n; ctx.moveTo(x, y); ctx.lineTo(x + Math.cos(b) * r, y + Math.sin(b) * r * sy); } ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillStyle = col; ctx.fillRect(x - 1, y - 1, 2, 2); }
  // walking there and back on a straight path, a rest at each end (with eased starts and stops): where, moving or not, which way
  function walkAt(o, t) { var P = o.p, dx = P[1][0] - P[0][0], dy = P[1][1] - P[0][1], T1 = Math.hypot(dx, dy) / o.v, cyc = 2 * (T1 + o.rest), u = ((t + o.ph) % cyc + cyc) % cyc, f, mv = 1, s = 1;
    if (u < T1) f = u / T1; else if (u < T1 + o.rest) { f = 1; mv = 0; } else if (u < 2 * T1 + o.rest) { f = 1 - (u - T1 - o.rest) / T1; s = -1; } else { f = 0; mv = 0; s = -1; }
    if (mv) { var g = f < .08 ? f * f / .16 : f > .92 ? 1 - (1 - f) * (1 - f) / .16 : f; f = g; }
    return { x: P[0][0] + dx * f, y: P[0][1] + dy * f, mv: mv, dx: dx * s, dy: dy * s }; }
  function walkBox(o) { var P = o.p; return [Math.min(P[0][0], P[1][0]) - 10, Math.min(P[0][1], P[1][1]) - 26, Math.max(P[0][0], P[1][0]) + 10, Math.max(P[0][1], P[1][1]) + 4]; }
  var PI_ = {};
  function person(ctx, o, q, now) { if (typeof TurboCity === 'undefined') return; try {
      var d = typeof personDirection === 'function' ? personDirection(q.dx, q.dy) : 4, pose = q.mv ? 'walking' : 'idle', k = o.a + '|' + d + '|' + pose, I = PI_[k];
      if (!I) { var J = TurboCity.info(o.a, { scale: 1, direction: d, pose: pose }), f = (J.an || []).find(function (a) { return a[0] === 'Feet'; }) || ['Feet', J.w / 2, J.h]; I = PI_[k] = { fx: f[1], fy: f[2] }; }
      try { if (typeof P34G !== 'undefined') P34G.k = o.id; } catch (e) {}
      TurboCity.draw(ctx, o.a, q.x - I.fx, q.y - I.fy, { mode: 'runtime', scale: 1, direction: d, pose: pose, time: now / 1000 }); } catch (e) { LIVE.err = LIVE.err || String(e && e.message || e); } }
  function people(ctx, list, t, now, v) { for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) { var o = list[i], b = o.bx || (o.bx = walkBox(o)); if (!inV(v, b[0], b[1], b[2], b[3])) continue; var q = walkAt(o, t); if (inV(v, q.x - 10, q.y - 24, q.x + 10, q.y + 4)) person(ctx, o, q, now); } }
  // the service pickup: the loop (the corners rounded), two stops; it eases into and out of each stop
  var VP = null;
  function vanPath() { if (VP) return VP; var V = M5.van, P = V.pts, r = V.r, pts = [], n = P.length;
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) { var a = P[(i + n - 1) % n], b = P[i], c = P[(i + 1) % n], d1x = Math.sign(b[0] - a[0]), d1y = Math.sign(b[1] - a[1]), d2x = Math.sign(c[0] - b[0]), d2y = Math.sign(c[1] - b[1]),
        cx = b[0] - d1x * r + d2x * r, cy = b[1] - d1y * r + d2y * r, a0 = Math.atan2(-d2y, -d2x), a1 = Math.atan2(d1y, d1x), da = a1 - a0;   // the arc's centre inside the corner, from (b − d1·r) to (b + d2·r)
      while (da > Math.PI) da -= TAU; while (da < -Math.PI) da += TAU; for (var k = 0; k <= 6; k++) { var aa = a0 + da * k / 6; pts.push([cx + Math.cos(aa) * r, cy + Math.sin(aa) * r]); } }
    pts.push(pts[0].slice()); var cum = [0]; for (var j = 1; j < pts.length; j++) cum.push(cum[j - 1] + Math.hypot(pts[j][0] - pts[j - 1][0], pts[j][1] - pts[j - 1][1]));
    var segs = [], prev = 0; V.stops.forEach(function (st) { segs.push([0, prev, st[0]]); segs.push([1, st[0], st[1]]); prev = st[0]; }); segs.push([0, prev, 1]);
    var bx = [1e9, 1e9, -1e9, -1e9]; pts.forEach(function (p) { bx[0] = Math.min(bx[0], p[0] - 40); bx[1] = Math.min(bx[1], p[1] - 40); bx[2] = Math.max(bx[2], p[0] + 40); bx[3] = Math.max(bx[3], p[1] + 40); });
    VP = { pts: pts, cum: cum, L: cum[cum.length - 1], segs: segs, box: bx }; return VP; }
  function vanAt(t) { var V = M5.van, P = vanPath(), Tt = P.L / V.v, T = Tt, i, s = 0, mv = 1; for (i = 0; i < V.stops.length; i++) T += V.stops[i][1];
    var u = (((t + V.ph) % T) + T) % T; for (i = 0; i < P.segs.length; i++) { var g = P.segs[i], dur = g[0] ? g[2] : (g[2] - g[1]) * Tt;
      if (u <= dur || i === P.segs.length - 1) { if (g[0]) { s = g[1] * P.L; mv = 0; } else { var f = Math.min(1, u / Math.max(1e-6, dur)); f = f * f * (3 - 2 * f); s = (g[1] + (g[2] - g[1]) * f) * P.L; } break; } u -= dur; }
    var j = 1; while (j < P.cum.length - 1 && P.cum[j] < s) j++; var a = P.pts[j - 1], b = P.pts[j], ff = (s - P.cum[j - 1]) / Math.max(1e-6, P.cum[j] - P.cum[j - 1]);
    return { x: a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * ff, y: a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * ff, h: Math.atan2(b[1] - a[1], b[0] - a[0]), mv: mv }; }
  // a moving vehicle in the city's 3/4 picture (its lights at night, the brake lamps at a stop, the reverse lamps backing); top-down only when there is no 3/4
  function vehicle(ctx, A, ref, sc, state, x, y, h, st, key, post, now) { try {
      if (typeof c34Live === 'function' && c34Live()) { var D = c34Dims(A, sc), id = (typeof fleetIsFrozen === 'function' && fleetIsFrozen(ref) && typeof c34Frz === 'function') ? c34Frz(c34Id(A, D[0], D[1])) : c34Id(A, D[0], D[1]);
        if (id && c34Push(id, c34Col(state), x, y, h, { opt: c34Opt(A, state, 'parked'), st: c34St(st.brake, st.rev, 0, true, false), q: c34Ratio(id, A, D[0]), key: key, r: D[0] * .6 + 12, post: post })) return; }
      var I = TurboCity.info(A, { scale: sc }); ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x, y); ctx.rotate(h); TurboCity.draw(ctx, A, -I.w / 2, -I.h / 2, { mode: 'runtime', scale: sc, state: state, time: now / 1000 }); ctx.restore(); if (post) post();
    } catch (e) { LIVE.err = LIVE.err || String(e && e.message || e); } }
  var VSC = null;
  function van(ctx, q, now) { var V = M5.van; if (typeof TurboCity === 'undefined') return; if (VSC == null) VSC = typeof roadVehicleScaleFor === 'function' ? roadVehicleScaleFor(V.asset, V.ref) : 1;
    vehicle(ctx, V.asset, V.ref, VSC, { c: V.c }, q.x, q.y, q.h, { brake: !q.mv, rev: false }, 'C5-SERVICE-PICKUP', null, now); }

  // the lamps' light on the ground at night (one glow picture)

    ctx.globalAlpha = ga; ctx.globalCompositeOperation = op; }
  var LIVE = { err: null };
  // ---------------- C5 ----------------
  function groundC5(ctx, C, N) {
    // the refinery yard, the filling apron
    var R = C.refinery;
    text(ctx, 'בית הזיקוק', (R.rect[0] + R.rect[2]) / 2, R.rect[1] + 20, 9, 'rgba(255,255,255,.7)');

    return TK.on = on; }

//   מה שזז מאחורי מבנה גבוה מוסתר בו, ומתחת לגשרי הצנרת הצינורות מעליו (occ); חניון הלילה החדש של D5 (נתיבים של 3.5 מ׳, השטיפה לרוחב, D5-01 החדש).
// (השם של הממשק נשאר C5D5LOOK5, כך שהקריאות של המשחק לא משתנות)
// 2.11 · C5D5LOOK5 — C5 ו-D5 מחדש (אחרי "חאפרי ברמה", הבעלים 18:33): בית הזיקוק כמתחם תעשייה אמיתי, הבלוק האמצעי לפי המפה, חניון הלילה.
// מבט 3/4 של העיר (BLD40): x מזרח, y דרום, z למעלה; 10 פיקס׳ = 1 מ׳; מסך = (x, y − 0.6·z) → מטר גובה = 6 פיקס׳. שמש אחת מצפון-מערב:
// נקודה בגובה z מטיל צל z·(2.5, 3.2) פיקס׳. רואים כל גג וכל קיר דרומי. N — לילה (צבעים כהים; האורות — lights()).
// הנתונים: c5d5v6.json. ground(ctx, D, N) — האספלט, הסימונים, המסילה, הגדר הנמוכה והחצצים; items(ctx, D, N) — כל מה שעומד, מצפון לדרום;
// lights(ctx, D, t) — מה שדולק בלילה (מעל שכבת הלילה); live(ctx, D, t, N) — להבה, עשן, אדים, מאווררים, מים (לשרטוט — רגע אחד).
(function () {
  var K = 6, TAU = Math.PI * 2, NOSH = false;   // NOSH: the depth pass redraws a structure over a mover — without its shadow a second time
  var P = { asph: ['#575c61', '#2b2f33'], asphL: ['#62676c', '#30343a'], pad: ['#a6a296', '#4b4945'], bund: ['#918c80', '#403e3a'], grav: ['#a19d92', '#45433f'],
    line: ['#ebe7dc', '#8f8c84'], yel: ['#e2b934', '#8a7426'], steel: ['#c4c8cb', '#5a5e62'], steelD: ['#8e9499', '#3e4246'], white: ['#e8e6df', '#6c6b67'], shellD: ['#b9b6ac', '#55534e'],
    red: ['#c0392b', '#6a2620'], conc: ['#b8b3a7', '#55524c'], concD: ['#9b968a', '#47443f'], rail: ['#8d9297', '#4c5054'], sleeper: ['#6b5a49', '#3a3129'], ballast: ['#8a8378', '#3e3b36'] };
  function c(k, N) { return P[k][N ? 1 : 0]; }
  function shadowBox(ctx, x0, y0, x1, y1, zm) { if (NOSH) return; var dx = 2.5 * zm, dy = 3.2 * zm; ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,16,24,.22)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0, y0); ctx.lineTo(x1, y0); ctx.lineTo(x1 + dx, y0 + dy); ctx.lineTo(x1 + dx, y1 + dy); ctx.lineTo(x0 + dx, y1 + dy); ctx.lineTo(x0, y1); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); }
  function shadowCyl(ctx, cx, cy, r, zm) { if (NOSH) return; ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(10,16,24,.22)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2 * r; ctx.lineCap = 'round'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx, cy); ctx.lineTo(cx + 2.5 * zm, cy + 3.2 * zm); ctx.stroke(); ctx.lineCap = 'butt'; }
  function shadowPole(ctx, x, y, zm, w) { if (NOSH) return; ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(10,16,24,.2)'; ctx.lineWidth = w || 2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y); ctx.lineTo(x + 2.5 * zm, y + 3.2 * zm); ctx.stroke(); }
  // a box: its south wall (a band zm·6 tall) and its roof (the plan lifted)
  function box3(ctx, x0, y0, x1, y1, zm, top, front, o) { o = o || {}; var H = zm * K; if (!o.noShadow) shadowBox(ctx, x0, y0, x1, y1, zm);
    ctx.fillStyle = front; ctx.fillRect(x0, y1 - H, x1 - x0, H); ctx.fillStyle = top; ctx.fillRect(x0, y0 - H, x1 - x0, y1 - y0);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.28)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.strokeRect(x0 + .5, y0 - H + .5, x1 - x0 - 1, y1 - y0 - 1); ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.18)'; ctx.fillRect(x0, y1 - H - 1, x1 - x0, 1); return H; }
  function windows(ctx, x0, x1, yb, zm, rows, N, lit, w, gap) { w = w || 5; gap = gap || 4; for (var r = 0; r < rows; r++) { var y = yb - (r + .45) * (zm / rows) * K - 3;
      for (var x = x0 + 4; x + w < x1 - 3; x += w + gap) { ctx.fillStyle = N ? (lit && ((x * 7 + r * 13) % 5 < 3) ? '#ffd98a' : '#1c2430') : '#3d5466'; ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, 4); ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.25)'; if (!N) ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, 1); } } }
  // a vertical cylinder (a tank, a column, a stack): the body lit from the west, its roof
  function cyl3(ctx, cx, cy, r, zm, shell, dark, roof, o) { o = o || {}; var H = zm * K; if (!o.noShadow) shadowCyl(ctx, cx, cy, r, zm);
    var g = ctx.createLinearGradient(cx - r, 0, cx + r, 0); g.addColorStop(0, shell); g.addColorStop(.55, shell); g.addColorStop(1, dark); ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx - r, cy - H); ctx.lineTo(cx - r, cy); ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, r, r * .5, 0, Math.PI, 0, true); ctx.lineTo(cx + r, cy - H); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = roof || shell; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, cy - H, r, r * .5, 0, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.25)'; ctx.lineWidth = .8; ctx.stroke(); return H; }
  function ring(ctx, cx, cy, rx, col, w) { ctx.strokeStyle = col; ctx.lineWidth = w || 1; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, rx, rx * .5, 0, 0, Math.PI); ctx.stroke(); }
  function rail(ctx, cx, ytop, rx, N) {   // a railing round a roof or a platform (the front half): posts and a rail
    ctx.strokeStyle = N ? '#7a6a2a' : '#e0b73a'; ctx.lineWidth = .9; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, ytop - 5, rx, rx * .5, 0, 0, Math.PI); ctx.stroke();
    for (var a = .15; a < Math.PI; a += .35) { var x = cx + Math.cos(a) * rx, y = ytop + Math.sin(a) * rx * .5; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y); ctx.lineTo(x, y - 5); ctx.stroke(); } }
  function ladder(ctx, x, yb, yt, N) { ctx.strokeStyle = N ? '#6b6f73' : '#4a4f54'; ctx.lineWidth = .8; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x - 1.6, yb); ctx.lineTo(x - 1.6, yt); ctx.moveTo(x + 1.6, yb); ctx.lineTo(x + 1.6, yt);
    for (var y = yb - 2; y > yt; y -= 2.6) { ctx.moveTo(x - 1.6, y); ctx.lineTo(x + 1.6, y); } ctx.stroke();
    ctx.lineWidth = .6; for (var y2 = yb - 14; y2 > yt + 2; y2 -= 6) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y2, 3.4, Math.PI * .1, Math.PI * .9, true); ctx.stroke(); } }   // the safety cage
  function stairsOn(ctx, cx, cy, r, H, N) {   // a stair round the tank's front, from its foot (east) to its roof (west), and the handrail
    ctx.strokeStyle = N ? '#5d6064' : '#5b6167'; ctx.lineWidth = 2.2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx + r * .92, cy + r * .2); ctx.lineTo(cx - r * .55, cy - H + r * .42); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = N ? '#8a7a3a' : '#e0b73a'; ctx.lineWidth = .8; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx + r * .92, cy + r * .2 - 5); ctx.lineTo(cx - r * .55, cy - H + r * .42 - 5); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.35)'; ctx.lineWidth = .6; for (var k = 0; k < 1; k += .06) { var x = cx + r * .92 + (cx - r * .55 - cx - r * .92) * k, y = cy + r * .2 + (cy - H + r * .42 - cy - r * .2) * k; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x - 1.4, y); ctx.lineTo(x + 1.4, y); ctx.stroke(); } }
  function label(ctx, t, x, y, fs, col) { ctx.save(); ctx.font = '700 ' + fs + 'px Arial'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle'; ctx.direction = 'rtl'; ctx.fillStyle = col; ctx.fillText(t, x, y); ctx.restore(); }
  function hdrum(ctx, x0, x1, cy, r, zm, shell, dark, N) {   // a horizontal drum (east–west) on two saddles
    var yc = cy - zm * K; shadowBox(ctx, x0, cy - r, x1, cy + r * .4, zm + r / 10); ctx.fillStyle = N ? '#3b3e42' : '#6b7075'; [x0 + 6, x1 - 10].forEach(function (x) { ctx.fillRect(x, yc + r * .6, 4, cy - yc - r * .6 + 1); });
    var g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, yc - r, 0, yc + r); g.addColorStop(0, shell); g.addColorStop(1, dark); ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0 + r * .5, yc - r); ctx.lineTo(x1 - r * .5, yc - r);
    ctx.ellipse(x1 - r * .5, yc, r * .5, r, 0, -Math.PI / 2, Math.PI / 2); ctx.lineTo(x0 + r * .5, yc + r); ctx.ellipse(x0 + r * .5, yc, r * .5, r, 0, Math.PI / 2, Math.PI * 1.5); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.25)'; ctx.lineWidth = .8; ctx.stroke(); }
  function pipeLine(ctx, pts, zm, col, w) { ctx.strokeStyle = col; ctx.lineWidth = w || 1.6; ctx.beginPath(); pts.forEach(function (p, i) { var y = p[1] - (p[2] != null ? p[2] : zm) * K; i ? ctx.lineTo(p[0], y) : ctx.moveTo(p[0], y); }); ctx.stroke(); }
  var PIPES = [['#9aa1a6', '#4a4e52'], ['#d9b43a', '#7a6624'], ['#b8392f', '#5e2420'], ['#4f8f6a', '#2e5340']];
  // a pipe rack: steel bents every 4 m, the beam, four pipes on top
  function rack(ctx, R, N) { var a = R.a, b = R.b, hz = R.h, H = hz * K, w = R.w, hor = Math.abs(b[0] - a[0]) > Math.abs(b[1] - a[1]), L = hor ? b[0] - a[0] : b[1] - a[1], n = Math.max(1, Math.round(L / 40));
    if (!NOSH) { ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,16,24,.16)'; if (hor) ctx.fillRect(a[0] + 2.5 * hz, a[1] - w / 2 + 3.2 * hz, L, w); else ctx.fillRect(a[0] - w / 2 + 2.5 * hz, a[1] + 3.2 * hz, w, L); }
    for (var i = 0; i <= n; i++) { var x = hor ? a[0] + L * i / n : a[0], y = hor ? a[1] : a[1] + L * i / n; ctx.fillStyle = c('steelD', N);
      if (hor) { ctx.fillRect(x - 1, y - w / 2 - H, 2, H); ctx.fillRect(x - 1, y + w / 2 - H, 2, H); ctx.fillRect(x - 1, y - w / 2 - H, 2, w); } else { ctx.fillRect(x - w / 2 - 1, y - H, 2, H); ctx.fillRect(x + w / 2 - 1, y - H, 2, H); ctx.fillRect(x - w / 2, y - H - 1, w, 2); } }
    for (var p = 0; p < 4; p++) { var off = -w / 2 + 2 + p * (w - 4) / 3; ctx.strokeStyle = PIPES[p][N ? 1 : 0]; ctx.lineWidth = p === 0 ? 2.4 : 1.7; ctx.beginPath();
      if (hor) { ctx.moveTo(a[0], a[1] + off - H - 1.5); ctx.lineTo(b[0], b[1] + off - H - 1.5); } else { ctx.moveTo(a[0] + off, a[1] - H - 1.5); ctx.lineTo(b[0] + off, b[1] - H - 1.5); } ctx.stroke(); } }
  // the chain-link fence: an east–west run is seen as a band 2.4 m tall; a north–south run edge-on (posts)
  function fenceRun(ctx, x0, y0, x1, y1, N, gaps) { var hor = Math.abs(x1 - x0) > Math.abs(y1 - y0), H = 2.4 * K, inGap = function (v) { return (gaps || []).some(function (g) { return v > g[0] && v < g[1]; }); };
    if (hor) { var a = Math.min(x0, x1), b = Math.max(x0, x1); for (var x = a; x < b; x += 2) { if (inGap(x + 1)) continue; ctx.fillStyle = N ? 'rgba(120,128,132,.28)' : 'rgba(205,212,214,.42)'; ctx.fillRect(x, y0 - H, 2, H); }
      ctx.strokeStyle = N ? '#5d6266' : '#6d7479'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; for (var x2 = a; x2 <= b; x2 += 30) { if (inGap(x2)) continue; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x2, y0); ctx.lineTo(x2, y0 - H - 2); ctx.stroke(); }
      ctx.lineWidth = .8; ctx.beginPath(); for (var s = a; s < b; s += 4) { if (inGap(s + 2)) continue; ctx.moveTo(s, y0 - H); ctx.lineTo(s + 4, y0 - H); ctx.moveTo(s, y0 - H - 2); ctx.lineTo(s + 2, y0 - H - 1.2); } ctx.stroke(); }
    else { var a2 = Math.min(y0, y1), b2 = Math.max(y0, y1); ctx.strokeStyle = N ? 'rgba(120,128,132,.6)' : 'rgba(150,158,162,.85)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.2; ctx.beginPath();
      for (var y = a2; y < b2; y += 2) { if (inGap(y + 1)) continue; ctx.moveTo(x0, y); ctx.lineTo(x0, y + 2); } ctx.stroke(); ctx.strokeStyle = N ? '#5d6266' : '#6d7479'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      for (var y3 = a2; y3 <= b2; y3 += 30) { if (inGap(y3)) continue; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0, y3); ctx.lineTo(x0, y3 - H - 2); ctx.stroke(); } } }
  function arm(ctx, x0, y0, x1, y1, z, N) { var H = z * K; ctx.fillStyle = N ? '#7e7a70' : '#e8e4da'; ctx.fillRect(x0 - 2.5, y0 - 9, 5, 9); ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
    for (var k = 0; k < 6; k++) { ctx.strokeStyle = k % 2 ? (N ? '#8a8780' : '#f4f2ec') : (N ? '#6a2620' : '#d23b2f'); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0 + (x1 - x0) * k / 6, y0 - H + (y1 - y0) * k / 6); ctx.lineTo(x0 + (x1 - x0) * (k + 1) / 6, y0 - H + (y1 - y0) * (k + 1) / 6); ctx.stroke(); } }
  function stalls(ctx, list, N, col) { ctx.strokeStyle = col || c('line', N); ctx.lineWidth = 1.4; list.forEach(function (s) { var x = s[0], y = s[1], w = s[2], h = s[3]; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y); ctx.lineTo(x, y + h); ctx.moveTo(x + w, y); ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h); ctx.moveTo(x, y); ctx.lineTo(x + w, y); ctx.stroke(); }); }
  function arrow(ctx, x, y, a, N) { ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x, y); ctx.rotate(a); ctx.fillStyle = c('line', N); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(9, 0); ctx.lineTo(1, -5); ctx.lineTo(1, -2); ctx.lineTo(-9, -2); ctx.lineTo(-9, 2); ctx.lineTo(1, 2); ctx.lineTo(1, 5); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.restore(); }
  function dashed(ctx, x0, y0, x1, y1, col, w, d) { ctx.strokeStyle = col; ctx.lineWidth = w || 1.2; ctx.setLineDash(d || [8, 6]); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0, y0); ctx.lineTo(x1, y1); ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]); }

  // ================= C5 · the refinery =================
  function groundRefinery(ctx, D, N) { var R = D.refinery, F = R.rect;
    ctx.fillStyle = c('asph', N); ctx.fillRect(F[0], F[1], F[2] - F[0], F[3] - F[1]);                                                     // asphalt everywhere inside the fence
    var B = R.bund.rect; ctx.fillStyle = c('bund', N); ctx.fillRect(B[0], B[1], B[2] - B[0], B[3] - B[1]);                                   // the bund's floor (concrete)
    var Pd = R.pad; ctx.fillStyle = c('pad', N); ctx.fillRect(Pd[0], Pd[1], Pd[2] - Pd[0], Pd[3] - Pd[1]);                                    // the process unit's pad
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.08)'; for (var x = Pd[0]; x < Pd[2]; x += 20) ctx.fillRect(x, Pd[1], .6, Pd[3] - Pd[1]); for (var y = Pd[1]; y < Pd[3]; y += 20) ctx.fillRect(Pd[0], y, Pd[2] - Pd[0], .6);
    [R.control.rect, R.cooling.rect, R.pumphouse.rect].forEach(function (r) { ctx.fillStyle = c('pad', N); ctx.fillRect(r[0] - 4, r[1] - 4, r[2] - r[0] + 8, r[3] - r[1] + 8); });
    var Cb = R.cooling.basin; ctx.fillStyle = c('conc', N); ctx.fillRect(Cb[0] - 2, Cb[1] - 1, Cb[2] - Cb[0] + 4, Cb[3] - Cb[1] + 3); ctx.fillStyle = N ? '#20404f' : '#3d7f9c'; ctx.fillRect(Cb[0], Cb[1], Cb[2] - Cb[0], Cb[3] - Cb[1]);
    // the service roads: edge lines, centre dashes, the arrows; the stop line at the gate
    R.roads.forEach(function (r) { var hor = (r[2] - r[0]) > (r[3] - r[1]); ctx.fillStyle = c('asphL', N); ctx.fillRect(r[0], r[1], r[2] - r[0], r[3] - r[1]);
      if (hor) { dashed(ctx, r[0], (r[1] + r[3]) / 2, r[2], (r[1] + r[3]) / 2, c('line', N)); ctx.fillStyle = c('yel', N); ctx.fillRect(r[0], r[1], r[2] - r[0], 1.2); ctx.fillRect(r[0], r[3] - 1.2, r[2] - r[0], 1.2); }
      else { dashed(ctx, (r[0] + r[2]) / 2, r[1], (r[0] + r[2]) / 2, r[3], c('line', N)); ctx.fillStyle = c('yel', N); ctx.fillRect(r[0], r[1], 1.2, r[3] - r[1]); ctx.fillRect(r[2] - 1.2, r[1], 1.2, r[3] - r[1]); } });
    ctx.fillStyle = c('line', N); ctx.fillRect(3016, 3826, 2.4, 33); label(ctx, 'עצור', 3002, 3851, 6, c('line', N));   /* p622: the out lane — the south half */
    var Cn = R.canopy.rect; ctx.fillStyle = c('pad', N); ctx.fillRect(Cn[0], Cn[1], Cn[2] - Cn[0], Cn[3] - Cn[1]);                          // the filling apron: concrete, the bays in yellow
    ctx.strokeStyle = c('yel', N); ctx.lineWidth = 1.6; ctx.strokeRect(R.canopy.truck - 18, Cn[1] + 6, 36, Cn[3] - Cn[1] - 12); ctx.strokeRect(2772, Cn[1] + 6, 36, Cn[3] - Cn[1] - 12);   /* p622: bay 2 for a tanker */
    if (R.pipe) pipeGround(ctx, D, N);   /* S7F266 (D‑504): PIPE-REF — its shadow, the low line in the bund, the valve station's pad (the temporary valve pit of p622 is out) */
    // the fence and its gates (the north–south runs edge-on, low)
    fenceRun(ctx, F[2], F[1], F[2], F[3], N, [[R.gate.open[0], R.gate.open[1]]]); fenceRun(ctx, F[0], F[1], F[0], F[3], N); }
  function tank(ctx, T, N) { var crude = T.kind === 'crude', H = cyl3(ctx, T.cx, T.cy, T.r, T.H, crude ? (N ? '#6d6a63' : '#e2ded2') : (N ? '#5f666b' : '#d4dde2'), N ? '#3c3a36' : '#9c988d', N ? '#57554f' : '#cfcbc0');
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.08)'; ctx.lineWidth = .7; for (var k = 1; k < 5; k++) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(T.cx, T.cy - H * k / 5, T.r, T.r * .5, 0, 0, Math.PI); ctx.stroke(); }   // the shell's courses
    ctx.fillStyle = crude ? (N ? '#3a3631' : '#7d6c55') : (N ? '#2e3a42' : '#5d7d93'); ctx.fillRect(T.cx - T.r * .8, T.cy - H * .55, T.r * 1.6, 3);                                   // the product band
    label(ctx, T.id, T.cx - T.r * .25, T.cy - H * .3, 8, N ? '#9a978f' : '#4b4a45'); stairsOn(ctx, T.cx, T.cy, T.r, H, N); rail(ctx, T.cx, T.cy - H, T.r * .98, N);
    ctx.fillStyle = N ? '#4b4e52' : '#8d9399'; ctx.fillRect(T.cx + 4, T.cy - H - 5, 5, 4); ctx.fillRect(T.cx - 10, T.cy - H - 2, 4, 3);                                         // the vents
    pipeLine(ctx, [[T.cx + T.r * .4, T.cy + T.r * .35, .8], [T.cx + T.r * .4, T.cy + T.r * .5 + 30, .8]], 0, PIPES[0][N ? 1 : 0], 2.2); }
  function sphere(ctx, S, N) { var zc = 4.2, yc = S.cy - zc * K - S.r * .2; shadowCyl(ctx, S.cx, S.cy, S.r, 7);
    ctx.strokeStyle = N ? '#3e4246' : '#7a8086'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.6; for (var i = 0; i < 6; i++) { var a = Math.PI * (i + .5) / 6, x = S.cx - S.r * Math.cos(a) * .95; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, S.cy + Math.sin(a) * 3); ctx.lineTo(x, yc + 2); ctx.stroke(); }
    var g = ctx.createRadialGradient(S.cx - S.r * .35, yc - S.r * .35, 2, S.cx, yc, S.r); g.addColorStop(0, N ? '#8a8a86' : '#ffffff'); g.addColorStop(1, N ? '#4a4a47' : '#bdbab1'); ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(S.cx, yc, S.r, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.25)'; ctx.lineWidth = .8; ctx.stroke(); ctx.strokeStyle = N ? '#7a6a2a' : '#e0b73a'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(S.cx + S.r, S.cy); ctx.lineTo(S.cx + 3, yc - S.r); ctx.stroke(); }
  function column(ctx, C, N) { var H = cyl3(ctx, C.cx, C.cy, C.r, C.H, N ? '#6f7377' : '#dfe3e5', N ? '#3c4044' : '#9aa1a6');
    ctx.fillStyle = N ? '#4a4844' : '#a8a397'; ctx.fillRect(C.cx - C.r, C.cy - 2 * K, 2 * C.r, 2 * K);                                                                      // the skirt
    for (var z = 6; z < C.H - 1; z += 6) { var yp = C.cy - z * K; ctx.fillStyle = N ? '#4d5054' : '#8c9297'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(C.cx, yp, C.r + 5, (C.r + 5) * .5, 0, 0, Math.PI); ctx.fill(); rail(ctx, C.cx, yp, C.r + 5, N); }   // the platforms
    rail(ctx, C.cx, C.cy - H, C.r + 4, N); ladder(ctx, C.cx - C.r * .55, C.cy - 2 * K, C.cy - H - 4, N);
    ctx.strokeStyle = N ? '#4a4e52' : '#5d6369'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(C.cx + C.r * .3, C.cy - H); ctx.lineTo(C.cx + C.r * .3, C.cy - H - 8); ctx.lineTo(C.cx + C.r * .3 + 7, C.cy - H - 8); ctx.stroke();   // the davit
    pipeLine(ctx, [[C.cx + C.r * .7, C.cy - H + 6, 0], [C.cx + C.r + 6, C.cy - H + 6, 0], [C.cx + C.r + 6, C.cy, 0]], 0, PIPES[0][N ? 1 : 0], 1.6);
    label(ctx, C.id, C.cx + C.r * .2, C.cy - H * .25, 7, N ? '#8f9396' : '#4b4f53'); }
  function heater(ctx, Hh, N) { var r = Hh.rect, H = box3(ctx, r[0], r[1], r[2], r[3], Hh.H, N ? '#4a3f3a' : '#7a6458', N ? '#3a302b' : '#8b4a33');

    ctx.fillStyle = N ? '#3a2c26' : '#5d3426'; for (var x2 = r[0] + 6; x2 < r[2] - 4; x2 += 10) ctx.fillRect(x2, r[3] - 6, 5, 4);                                                    // the burner ports

  function flareStack(ctx, F, N) { var x = F.x, y = F.y, h = F.H * K; hdrum(ctx, F.drum[0], F.drum[2], F.drum[3], 6, 1.4, N ? '#6f7377' : '#d6dade', N ? '#3c4044' : '#959ca1', N); shadowPole(ctx, x, y, F.H, 2.5);

  function canopy(ctx, Cp, N, part) { var r = Cp.rect, H = Cp.H * K, cols = [r[0] + 3, (r[0] + r[2]) / 2, r[2] - 3];   // part: 'base' (the columns, the platform) | 'roof' (over the vehicles — the game's overhead pass) | all
    if (part !== 'roof') {
    ctx.fillStyle = N ? '#55534e' : '#b3ad9f'; ctx.fillRect(2810, r[1] + 16, 22, r[3] - r[1] - 30); ctx.fillStyle = N ? '#46443f' : '#968f80'; ctx.fillRect(2810, r[3] - 14 - 1.2 * K, 22, 1.2 * K);   // the loading platform between the lanes
    cols.forEach(function (x) { [r[1] + 4, r[3] - 4].forEach(function (y) { ctx.fillStyle = N ? '#4e5256' : '#7c8287'; ctx.fillRect(x - 1.5, y - H, 3, H); }); });
    if (!NOSH) { ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,16,24,.18)'; ctx.fillRect(r[0] + 2.5 * Cp.H, r[1] + 3.2 * Cp.H, r[2] - r[0], r[3] - r[1]); } }
    if (part === 'base') return;
    var ga = ctx.globalAlpha; ctx.globalAlpha = ga * .5; ctx.fillStyle = N ? '#5e5d58' : '#d9d6cc'; ctx.fillRect(r[0] - 4, r[1] - H - 4, r[2] - r[0] + 8, r[3] - r[1] + 4);   // the roof: polycarbonate sheets — see-through
    ctx.globalAlpha = ga * .7; ctx.strokeStyle = N ? '#3e3d39' : '#8d897e'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.2; for (var x2 = r[0]; x2 < r[2]; x2 += 24) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x2, r[1] - H - 4); ctx.lineTo(x2, r[3] - H); ctx.stroke(); }   // the purlins
    ctx.strokeRect(r[0] - 4, r[1] - H - 4, r[2] - r[0] + 8, r[3] - r[1] + 4); ctx.globalAlpha = ga * .92;
    for (var k = 0; k < (r[2] - r[0] + 8) / 8; k++) { ctx.fillStyle = k % 2 ? (N ? '#7a7872' : '#f4f2ec') : (N ? '#6a2620' : '#c8352b'); ctx.fillRect(r[0] - 4 + k * 8, r[3] - H, 8, 5); }   // the fascia
    ctx.globalAlpha = ga; label(ctx, 'עמדת מילוי מכליות', (r[0] + r[2]) / 2, r[3] - H + 2.5, 5, N ? '#ddd' : '#111'); }

  function puff(ctx, x, y, r, col, a) { var g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + col + ',' + a + ')'); g.addColorStop(.6, 'rgba(' + col + ',' + (a * .6) + ')'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + col + ',0)'); ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(x - r, y - r, 2 * r, 2 * r); }
  function live(ctx, D, t, N) { var R = D.refinery, F = R.flare, fx = F.x, fy = F.y - F.H * K - 3, wx = .85;

    var S = R.heater.stack, sy = S.cy - S.H * K; for (var j = 0; j < 9; j++) { var v = (t * .16 + j / 9) % 1; puff(ctx, S.cx + wx * 85 * v, sy - 4 - 80 * v * (2 - v), 3 + 13 * v, N ? '96,92,86' : '128,124,118', .42 * (1 - v)); }

  // ================= the depth pass (3/4, p511 — the owner 20:29): a tall structure in front of a mover (its foot south of the mover's) is drawn
  // again over it, clipped to the mover's box; a pipe rack — always over what passes under it. A recording context gives each structure its box once.
  var REC = (function () { var b = null, tx = 0, ty = 0, st = [], g = { addColorStop: function () {} };
    function P(x, y) { x += tx; y += ty; if (!(x === x && y === y)) return; if (!b) b = [x, y, x, y]; else { if (x < b[0]) b[0] = x; if (y < b[1]) b[1] = y; if (x > b[2]) b[2] = x; if (y > b[3]) b[3] = y; } }
    var n = function () {};
    return { fillRect: function (x, y, w, h) { P(x, y); P(x + w, y + h); }, strokeRect: function (x, y, w, h) { P(x, y); P(x + w, y + h); }, rect: function (x, y, w, h) { P(x, y); P(x + w, y + h); }, clearRect: n,
      moveTo: P, lineTo: P, quadraticCurveTo: function (a, q, x, y) { P(a, q); P(x, y); }, bezierCurveTo: function (a, q, c2, d, x, y) { P(a, q); P(c2, d); P(x, y); },
      arc: function (x, y, r) { P(x - r, y - r); P(x + r, y + r); }, ellipse: function (x, y, rx, ry) { P(x - rx, y - ry); P(x + rx, y + ry); },
      fillText: function (t, x, y) { P(x - 24, y - 6); P(x + 24, y + 6); }, strokeText: n, measureText: function (t) { return { width: String(t).length * 4 }; },
      drawImage: function (im, x, y, w, h) { if (h != null) { P(x, y); P(x + w, y + h); } }, translate: function (x, y) { tx += x; ty += y; },
      save: function () { st.push([tx, ty]); }, restore: function () { var q = st.pop(); if (q) { tx = q[0]; ty = q[1]; } },
      beginPath: n, closePath: n, fill: n, stroke: n, clip: n, setLineDash: n, rotate: n, scale: n, setTransform: n, resetTransform: n, getTransform: function () { return { a: 1, b: 0 }; },
      createLinearGradient: function () { return g; }, createRadialGradient: function () { return g; }, createPattern: function () { return null; },
      start: function () { b = null; tx = ty = 0; st = []; }, box: function () { return b; } }; })();
  function lists(ctx, D, N) { return refList(ctx, D, N).concat(midList(ctx, D, N, function () {})); }
  function occBoxes(D, N) { if (D.__occ && D.__occN === N) return D.__occ; var L = lists(REC, D, N), B = [];
    L.forEach(function (e) { REC.start(); NOSH = true; try { e[1](); } catch (x) {} NOSH = false; var b = REC.box(); B.push(b ? [b[0] - 2, b[1] - 2, b[2] + 2, b[3] + 2] : null); });
    D.__occ = B; D.__occN = N; return B; }
  function occList(D, N) { var B = occBoxes(D, N), L = lists(REC, D, N); return L.map(function (e, i) { return { key: e[0], over: !!e.over, box: B[i] }; }); }
  // movers: [{box: [x0, y0, x1, y1], y: the foot}] · extra: [[key, draw, ] + .bb, .over] (the city's BLD40 buildings) → how many structures were drawn again
  function occ(ctx, D, N, movers, extra) { if (!movers || !movers.length) return 0; var B = occBoxes(D, N), L = null, n = 0;
    movers.forEach(function (m) { var hit = [], mb = m.box;
      for (var i = 0; i < B.length; i++) { var b = B[i]; if (!b || b[2] < mb[0] || b[0] > mb[2] || b[3] < mb[1] || b[1] > mb[3]) continue;
        if (!L) L = lists(ctx, D, N); var e = L[i]; if (e.over || e[0] > m.y) hit.push(e); }
      (extra || []).forEach(function (e) { var b = e.bb; if (!b || b[2] < mb[0] || b[0] > mb[2] || b[3] < mb[1] || b[1] > mb[3]) return; if (e.over || e[0] > m.y) hit.push(e); });
      if (!hit.length) return; hit.sort(function (a, b) { return a[0] - b[0]; });
      ctx.save(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(mb[0], mb[1], mb[2] - mb[0], mb[3] - mb[1]); ctx.clip(); NOSH = true;
      try { hit.forEach(function (e) { e[1](); }); } catch (x) {} NOSH = false; ctx.restore(); n += hit.length; });
    return n; }
  // ================= C5 · PIPE-REF (S7F266 · D‑504) — the crude line from the oil jetty (S10) to the tank farm, on a high pipe bridge: the part in C5 =================
  // From tank T-101 south at x 2728: the map's spur corridor (x 2780) runs through the covered filling station and beside column C-103 — 2728 is the nearest lane clear

  function pcol(N) { return N ? '#80878c' : '#c4cacf'; } function pcolD(N) { return N ? '#4f565b' : '#8e979d'; }
  function vpipe(ctx, x, ya, yb, w, N) { ctx.strokeStyle = pcolD(N); ctx.lineWidth = w + 1.2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, ya); ctx.lineTo(x, yb); ctx.stroke(); ctx.strokeStyle = pcol(N); ctx.lineWidth = w; ctx.stroke();

  function pipeGround(ctx, D, N) { var P = D.refinery.pipe, x = P.x, z = P.z, c0 = P.cols[0], c1 = P.cols[P.cols.length - 1], V = P.valve;

    ctx.fillStyle = c('concD', N); for (var y = P.tank[1] + 6; y < c0 - 2; y += 9) ctx.fillRect(x - 6, y, 12, 2.4);   // the low line in the bund, on sleepers
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.25)'; ctx.lineWidth = 5.5; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + 1, P.tank[1] + 2); ctx.lineTo(x + 1, c0); ctx.stroke(); vpipe(ctx, x, P.tank[1] - 3, c0 - 4, 4.4, N);
    ctx.fillStyle = N ? '#46443f' : '#a6a297'; ctx.fillRect(V[0], V[1], V[2] - V[0], V[3] - V[1]); ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.12)'; for (var i = 0; i < 30; i++) ctx.fillRect(V[0] + 2 + (i * 7) % (V[2] - V[0] - 4), V[1] + 2 + (i * 11) % (V[3] - V[1] - 4), 1.3, 1.3);   // the gravel
    ctx.fillStyle = c('conc', N); ctx.fillRect(x - 4, V[1] + 2, 8, V[3] - V[1] - 4);                                                           // the plinth of the line at grade
    [V[3] + 1, P.riser - 6].forEach(function (y) { ctx.fillStyle = N ? '#8a7426' : '#e2b934'; ctx.fillRect(x + 6, y, 3, 3); ctx.fillStyle = '#1f2326'; ctx.fillRect(x + 6, y + 1, 3, .8); }); }   // the marker posts of the sleeve under the road

/* p574 (rule 29 · the owner 4.11 00:52): one dog for the whole city — a 3/4 dog drawn as a body in space (a swept tube of sections), four legs with a

function fx2Mitre(e,k,off){const n=byNode[e[k]],J=fx2Joint(n);if(!J||J.straight||!off)return 0;const i=J.edges.indexOf(e.id);if(i<0)return 0;

function s13IslandTrainDef(lag,home){const L2=RAIL_SEG_BY_ID['ISL-A2'].len;home=home==null?200:home;return{id:'TST-ISL',label:'רכבת הבדיקה של האי · קטר וקרון',vmax:80,lag:lag==null?520:lag,

function s13IslandTrainBuild(D){const T={id:D.id,label:D.label,off:0,vmax:D.vmax||RL_V,cars:D.cars.map(c=>({...c,len:rlCarLen(c.asset)})),runs:[],err:null};

  T.offFwd=off(T.cars.map((_,i)=>i));T.offRev=off(T.cars.map((_,i)=>T.cars.length-1-i));let t=0;
  for(const R of D.runs){const P=rlPathBuild(R.legs),prof=rlRunProfile(R.legs,P,T.L,T.vmax);T.runs.push({...R,P,d:P.len-T.L,tm:prof.T,prof,t0:t,t1:t+prof.T,tEnd:t+prof.T+R.dwell});t+=prof.T+R.dwell}

/* הבדיקה עצמה (בלי לשנות את המשחק): כל המחזור, כל 1 שנ׳ — הרכבת עוברת בפס א׳ אל האי ובפס ב׳ בחזרה, בלי מפגש עם רכבת אחרת, והזמנים שבהם היא על המפתח */
function s13IslandTrainTest(lag){const T=s13IslandTrainBuild(s13IslandTrainDef(lag)),out={ok:false,err:T.err,cycle:T.cycle?Math.round(T.cycle):null,segsIn:{},segsOut:{},hits:[],onSpan:[],island:null,home:null};if(T.err)return out;

  if(!S.moving){const h=cars[0];if(S.R.stop==='island'&&!out.island)out.island=[Math.round(h.x),Math.round(h.y)];if(S.R.stop==='home'&&!out.home)out.home=[Math.round(h.x),Math.round(h.y)]}

var B12_BOAT={id:'B1-BOAT-1',kind:'boat',label:'סירת המשוטים של האגם',phase:'moored',T:0,next:60,t0:0,trips:0,x:0,y:0,h:Math.PI,L:0,cum:null,v:0,round:240,wait:240};
function b12BoatPose(s){const R=B12.boatRoute,C=B12_BOAT.cum;for(let i=1;i<R.length;i++)if(s<=C[i]||i===R.length-1){const a=R[i-1],b=R[i],u=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(s-C[i-1])/((C[i]-C[i-1])||1)));return[a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*u,a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*u,Math.atan2(b[1]-a[1],b[0]-a[0])]}return[R[0][0],R[0][1],Math.PI]}

 if(id==='B3-SERVICE'&&(act==='refuel'||act==='repair')){if(PlayerProfile.mode!=='vehicle'||carKmh()>2)return toast('עצור את הרכב בתוך אזור העמדה');const eco=activeVehicleEco();if(act==='refuel'){const need=Math.max(0,100-(eco.fuel??100));if(need<.5)return toast('המיכל כבר מלא');const pct=Math.min(Math.ceil(need),Math.floor(PlayerProfile.money/LOT_FUEL_PER_PCT));if(pct<=0)return toast('אין מספיק כסף לתדלוק');const cost=pct*LOT_FUEL_PER_PCT;pay(cost,'refuel',{pct});eco.fuel=Math.min(100,(eco.fuel??0)+pct);SaveManager.log('economy','refuel',{pct,cost,lot:id});SaveManager.save('lot-refuel',{backup:false,silent:true});toast('תודלק '+pct+'% · '+money(cost))}else{const dmg=Math.max(0,eco.damage??0);if(dmg<.5)return toast('הרכב לא צריך תיקון');const fix=Math.min(Math.ceil(dmg),Math.floor(PlayerProfile.money/LOT_REPAIR_PER_PCT));if(fix<=0)return toast('אין מספיק כסף לתיקון');const cost=fix*LOT_REPAIR_PER_PCT;pay(cost,'repair',{fix});eco.damage=Math.max(0,dmg-fix);SaveManager.log('economy','repair',{fix,cost,lot:id});SaveManager.save('lot-repair',{backup:false,silent:true});toast('תוקן '+fix+'% · '+money(cost))}return renderPhone()}

function vehicleSnapshot(){return{asset:PlayerCar.asset,ref:PlayerCar.ref||'Sedan',state:cloneJson(PlayerCar.state||{}),x:PlayerCar.x,y:PlayerCar.y,heading:PlayerCar.heading}}
function applyVehicleSnapshot(v,{keepPosition=false}={}){if(!v)return;const x=keepPosition?PlayerCar.x:v.x,y=keepPosition?PlayerCar.y:v.y,h=keepPosition?PlayerCar.heading:v.heading;PlayerCar.asset=TurboCity.get(v.asset)?v.asset:PLAYER_VEHICLE_ID;PlayerCar.ref=v.ref||'Sedan';PlayerCar.state=cloneJson(v.state||{});PlayerCar.x=x;PlayerCar.y=y;PlayerCar.heading=safeNum(h,0);PlayerCar.speed=0;PlayerCar.steer=0;PlayerCar.hitCooldown=0;State.vehicleEcoOverride=null;PlayerProfile.mode='vehicle';Camera.x=PlayerCar.x;Camera.y=PlayerCar.y}
function setTemporaryVehicle(v){PlayerCar.asset=v.asset;PlayerCar.ref=v.ref;PlayerCar.state={};PlayerCar.speed=0;PlayerCar.steer=0;PlayerCar.hitCooldown=0;State.vehicleEcoOverride={fuel:100,damage:0,temporary:true}}
function licenseOwned(id){return PlayerProfile.licenses?.[id]?.state==='owned'}
function licenseTrialStatus(id){if(licenseOwned(id))return'owned';if(State.licenseExam?.id===id)return'exam';const r=LICENSE_TRIALS[id];if(!r)return'locked';return(!r.required||licenseOwned(r.required))?'eligible':'locked'}
function startLicenseTrial(id){ensureEconomySchema();const r=LICENSE_TRIALS[id];if(!r)return toast('הרישיון הזה ייפתח עם המערכת שלו');if(licenseOwned(id))return toast('הרישיון כבר בבעלותך');if(r.required&&!licenseOwned(r.required))return toast('חסר רישיון מקדים');if(PlayerProfile.activeMission)return toast('סיים או בטל את המשימה הפעילה קודם');if(PlayerProfile.mode!=='vehicle')return toast('המבחן המעשי מתחיל מתוך רכב');if(carKmh()>2)return toast('עצור את הרכב לפני התחלת מבחן');if(PlayerProfile.money<r.fee)return toast('אין מספיק כסף לאגרת המבחן');PlayerProfile.money-=r.fee;recordTransaction('license-exam-fee',-r.fee,{license:id});const old=PlayerProfile.licenses[id]||{state:'eligible',attempts:0,bestScore:null};PlayerProfile.licenses[id]={...old,state:'eligible',attempts:(old.attempts||0)+1};State.licenseExam={id,startDistance:PlayerProfile.stats.distanceMeters||0,startCollisions:PlayerCar.collisions||0,meters:r.meters,startedAt:performance.now(),returnVehicle:vehicleSnapshot()};setTemporaryVehicle(r.vehicle);SaveManager.log('license','exam_started',{id,fee:r.fee,meters:r.meters,vehicle:r.vehicle.asset});SaveManager.save('license-start',{backup:false,silent:true});setPhoneOpen(false);toast('מבחן '+r.name+' · '+r.vehicle.label+' · '+r.meters+' מ׳ ללא התנגשות')}
function finishLicenseTrial(passed,reason='done'){const e=State.licenseExam;if(!e)return;const id=e.id,ret=e.returnVehicle;if(passed){const cur=PlayerProfile.licenses[id]||{};PlayerProfile.licenses[id]={...cur,state:'owned',acquiredAt:iso(),bestScore:100};SaveManager.log('license','exam_passed',{id,vehicle:LICENSE_TRIALS[id].vehicle.asset})}else SaveManager.log('license','exam_failed',{id,reason});State.licenseExam=null;applyVehicleSnapshot(ret);SaveManager.save(passed?'license-pass':'license-fail',{backup:passed,silent:true});toast(passed?'הרישיון עבר בהצלחה · חזרת לרכב שלך':'המבחן נכשל — '+(reason==='collision'?'התנגשות':'בוטל')+' · חזרת לרכב שלך')}
function updateLicenseTrial(){const e=State.licenseExam;if(!e)return;if(PlayerProfile.mode!=='vehicle')return finishLicenseTrial(false,'exit');if((PlayerCar.collisions||0)>e.startCollisions)return finishLicenseTrial(false,'collision');const done=(PlayerProfile.stats.distanceMeters||0)-e.startDistance;if(done>=e.meters)finishLicenseTrial(true)}
function licenseTrialProgress(){const e=State.licenseExam;if(!e)return null;return Math.max(0,(PlayerProfile.stats.distanceMeters||0)-e.startDistance)}

function nearestRoadNode(x,y){let best=null;for(const n of NODES){const d=Math.hypot(x-n.x,y-n.y);if(!best||d<best.d)best={id:n.id,d}}return best}
function shortestNodePath(startId,endId,edgeOk=null){if(startId===endId)return[startId];const dist={},prev={},open=new Set(NODES.map(n=>n.id));for(const n of NODES)dist[n.id]=Infinity;dist[startId]=0;while(open.size){let u=null,du=Infinity;for(const id of open)if(dist[id]<du){u=id;du=dist[id]}if(u==null||u===endId)break;open.delete(u);for(const e of incident(u)){if(edgeOk&&!edgeOk(e))continue;const v=e.a===u?e.b:e.a;if(!open.has(v))continue;const a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b],alt=du+Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y);if(alt<dist[v]){dist[v]=alt;prev[v]=u}}}if(!Number.isFinite(dist[endId]))return[];const out=[endId];let q=endId;while(q!==startId){q=prev[q];if(!q)return[];out.push(q)}return out.reverse()}
function routeDistancePx(points){let d=0;for(let i=1;i<points.length;i++)d+=Math.hypot(points[i].x-points[i-1].x,points[i].y-points[i-1].y);return d}
function recalcNavigation(){const nav=State.navigation;if(!nav)return;const a=playerActor(),poi=navPoiRegistry()[nav.targetId]||nav.target;if(!poi){State.navigation=null;return}if(PlayerProfile.mode==='walk'&&((currentActorChunk()==='A6'&&poi.chunk==='A6')||(currentActorChunk()==='C5'&&poi.chunk==='C5')||(currentActorChunk()==='A4'&&poi.chunk==='A4')||(currentActorChunk()==='B5'&&poi.chunk==='B5')||(currentActorChunk()==='E2'&&poi.chunk==='E2'))){const pts=poi.chunk==='A6'?b5PedRoute(a,poi,A6_PATHS):poi.chunk==='C5'?b5PedRoute(a,poi,C5_PATHS):poi.chunk==='A4'?b5PedRoute(a,poi,A4_NAV_PATHS):poi.chunk==='E2'?e2PedRoute(a,poi):b5PedRoute(a,poi);if(pts.length){nav.target={...poi};nav.nodePath=[];nav.points=pts;nav.distanceMeters=routeDistancePx(pts)*WORLD_METERS_PER_PX;nav.lastX=a.x;nav.lastY=a.y;State.navLastCalc=performance.now();return}}if(/^(D5-FK-|ACT-)/.test(nav.targetId)){nav.target={...poi};nav.nodePath=[];nav.points=[{x:a.x,y:a.y},{x:poi.x,y:poi.y}];nav.distanceMeters=Math.hypot(a.x-poi.x,a.y-poi.y)*WORLD_METERS_PER_PX;nav.lastX=a.x;nav.lastY=a.y;State.navLastCalc=performance.now();return}const sn=nearestRoadNode(a.x,a.y),tn=poi.navNode&&byNode[poi.navNode]?byNode[poi.navNode]:nearestRoadNode(poi.x,poi.y),ids=shortestNodePath(sn.id,tn.id),pts=[{x:a.x,y:a.y},...ids.map(id=>({x:byNode[id].x,y:byNode[id].y})),...(poi.navVia||[]),{x:poi.x,y:poi.y}];nav.target={...poi};nav.nodePath=ids;nav.points=pts;nav.distanceMeters=routeDistancePx(pts)*WORLD_METERS_PER_PX;nav.lastX=a.x;nav.lastY=a.y;State.navLastCalc=performance.now()}
function setNavigationTarget(id,{mission=false,silent=false}={}){if(PlayerProfile.activeMission&&!mission)return toast('במשימה פעילה הניווט נעול ליעד המשימה');const poi=navPoiRegistry()[id];if(!poi)return toast('יעד ניווט לא קיים');State.navigation={targetId:id,target:{...poi},mission:!!mission,nodePath:[],points:[],distanceMeters:0,lastX:null,lastY:null};recalcNavigation();SaveManager.log('navigation','target_set',{id,mission:!!mission});if(!silent)toast('ניווט: '+poi.label);if(State.phoneOpen)renderPhone();return true}
function clearNavigation({force=false,silent=false}={}){if(PlayerProfile.activeMission&&!force)return toast('הניווט נעול למשימה הפעילה');const old=State.navigation?.targetId;State.navigation=null;if(old)SaveManager.log('navigation','target_cleared',{id:old});if(!silent&&old)toast('הניווט בוטל');if(State.phoneOpen)renderPhone()}
function updateNavigation(now){const n=State.navigation;if(!n)return;const a=playerActor();if(!n.lastX||Math.hypot(a.x-n.lastX,a.y-n.lastY)>70||now-State.navLastCalc>700)recalcNavigation();if(!PlayerProfile.activeMission&&n.target&&Math.hypot(a.x-n.target.x,a.y-n.target.y)<55){const label=n.target.label;clearNavigation({force:true,silent:true});toast('הגעת ליעד · '+label)}}
function drawNavigationWorld(now){const n=State.navigation;if(!n?.points?.length)return;ctx.save();ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.lineJoin='round';ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(55,218,255,.9)';ctx.lineWidth=8/Math.max(.8,Camera.zoom);ctx.shadowColor='rgba(55,218,255,.75)';ctx.shadowBlur=10/Camera.zoom;ctx.beginPath();n.points.forEach((p,i)=>i?ctx.lineTo(p.x,p.y):ctx.moveTo(p.x,p.y));ctx.stroke();ctx.shadowBlur=0;const t=n.target,pulse=13+Math.sin(now/180)*3;ctx.strokeStyle='#ffe08a';ctx.lineWidth=3/Camera.zoom;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(t.x,t.y,pulse/Camera.zoom,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();ctx.restore()}
function drawNavigationMap(c,T){const n=State.navigation;if(!n?.points?.length)return;c.save();c.strokeStyle='#39d9ff';c.lineWidth=2.8;c.lineCap='round';c.lineJoin='round';c.beginPath();n.points.forEach((p,i)=>i?c.lineTo(T.x(p.x),T.y(p.y)):c.moveTo(T.x(p.x),T.y(p.y)));c.stroke();if(n.target){c.fillStyle='#ffe08a';c.beginPath();c.arc(T.x(n.target.x),T.y(n.target.y),4.5,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill()}c.restore()}

function forkliftMissionAction(){const m=anyForkliftMission();if(!m)return false;const d=MISSION_DEFS[m.id],task=forkliftTask(m),target=m.stage==='forklift-drop'?task.drop:task.pickup,dist=Math.hypot(PlayerCar.x-target.x,PlayerCar.y-target.y);if(PlayerCar.asset!=='LV-FK-01'||PlayerProfile.mode!=='vehicle')return toast('צריך להיות על המלגזה');if(carKmh()>3)return toast('עצור את המלגזה לפני הרמה או הנחה');if(dist>38)return toast('התקרב לריבוע המסומן');if(m.stage==='forklift-pickup'){m.stage='forklift-drop';m.payload=true;setNavigationTarget(task.drop.id,{mission:true,silent:true});SaveManager.log('mission','forklift_pickup',{id:m.id,pallet:task.id,index:m.forkliftIndex});SaveManager.save('forklift-pickup',{backup:false,silent:true});toast('המשטח על המזלגות · סע לריבוע הירוק ולחץ F');return true}m.payload=false;m.forkliftIndex=(m.forkliftIndex||0)+1;SaveManager.log('mission','forklift_drop',{id:m.id,pallet:task.id,index:m.forkliftIndex});if(m.forkliftIndex>=forkTasks(m).length)return missionComplete();m.stage='forklift-pickup';const next=forkliftTask(m);setNavigationTarget(next.pickup.id,{mission:true,silent:true});SaveManager.save('forklift-drop',{backup:false,silent:true});toast('המשטח הונח · עבור למשטח '+(m.forkliftIndex+1)+' ולחץ F');return true}

'+(p?.label||d.start));}if(State.a4Game&&State.a4Game.phase!=='done')return toast('סיים את אימון הספורט קודם');if(PlayerProfile.mode!=='vehicle'&&!d.walk&&!C4_JOBS.includes(id))return toast('התחל את המשימה');if(d.type==='bus'){PlayerProfile.activeMission={id:d.id,stage:'bus-route',reward:d.reward,timeRemaining:d.timeLimit,startCollisions:PlayerCar.collisions||0,returnVehicle:vehicleSnapshot(),startedAt:iso(),busStopIndex:0,stopHold:0,passengers:0,passengersServed:0,stopVisits:0};setTemporaryVehicle(d.vehicle);setNavigationTarget(busPlayerStops(PlayerProfile.activeMission)[0].id,{mission:true,silent:true});SaveManager.log('mission','mission_state',{id:d.id,state:'started',stage:'bus-route',vehicle:d.vehicle.asset});SaveManager.save('mission-start',{backup:true,silent:true});setPhoneOpen(false);return function missionFail(reason='failed'){const m=PlayerProfile.activeMission;if(!m)return;const id=m.id,ret=m.returnVehicle,d=MISSION_DEFS[id];PlayerProfile.activeMission=null;clearNavigation({force:true,silent:true});if(d?.type==='ground-training')ew2RestoreJob(m);else if(d?.type==='forklift')restoreForkliftOperator(m);else if(!actRestore(m,d))applyVehicleSnapshot(ret,{keepPosition:true});SaveManager.log('mission','mission_state',{id,state:'failed',reason});SaveManager.save('mission-fail',{backup:false,silent:true});toast(reason==='strikes'?'המשמרת נכשלה — שלוש טעויות סריקה':reason==='collision'?'המשימה נכשלה — התנגשות':'המשימה נכשלה — הזמן נגמר')}
function missionComplete(){ensureEconomySchema();const m=PlayerProfile.activeMission;if(!m)return;const d=MISSION_DEFS[m.id],ret=m.returnVehicle,collisions=Math.max(0,(PlayerCar.collisions||0)-(m.startCollisions||0)),passengerBonus=d.type==='bus'?(m.passengersServed||0)*18:0,collisionPenalty=d.type==='bus'?Math.min(400,collisions*80):0,reward=Math.max(0,d.reward+passengerBonus-collisionPenalty+actBonus(m,d)+f2PickupBonus(m,d));PlayerProfile.money+=reward;recordTransaction('mission-reward',reward,{mission:d.id,jobKey:d.jobKey,base:d.reward,passengerBonus,collisionPenalty});const actSuffix=actOnComplete(m,d,reward);a4OnMissionComplete(m,d);f1OnComplete(m,d);f2OnComplete(m,d);g2OnComplete(m,d);ew2OnComplete(m,d);if(!PlayerProfile.progression.completedMissions.includes(d.id))PlayerProfile.progression.completedMissions.push(d.id);PlayerProfile.progression.jobLevels[d.jobKey]=(PlayerProfile.progression.jobLevels[d.jobKey]||0)+1;PlayerProfile.activeMission=null;clearNavigation({force:true,silent:true});if(d.type==='ground-training')ew2RestoreJob(m);else if(d.type==='forklift')restoreForkliftOperator(m);else if(!actRestore(m,d))applyVehicleSnapshot(ret,{keepPosition:true});SaveManager.log('mission','mission_state',{id:d.id,state:'completed',reward,jobKey:d.jobKey,passengersServed:m.passengersServed||0,collisions});syncAchievements(true);SaveManager.save('mission-complete',{backup:true,silent:true});toast(d.type==='shift'?actCompleteText(m,d,reward,actSuffix):d.type==='bus'?`קו ${d.id==='M-BUS-04'?4:1} הושלם · ${m.passengersServed||0} נוסעים · קיבלת ${money(reward)}`:d.type==='forklift'?`עבודת המלגזה הושלמה · ${D5_FORKLIFT_TASKS.length} משטחים · קיבלת ${money(reward)}${actSuffix}`:'משימה הושלמה · קיבלת '+money(reward)+actSuffix)}
function updateBusDriverMission(dt,m,d){m.timeRemaining=Math.max(0,(m.timeRemaining??d.timeLimit)-dt);if(m.timeRemaining<=0)return missionFail('timeout');if(PlayerCar.asset!==d.vehicle.asset||PlayerProfile.mode!=='vehicle'){m.stopHold=0;return}const stop=busMissionStop(m),final=(m.busStopIndex||0)>=busPlayerStops(m).length,dist=Math.hypot(PlayerCar.x-stop.busX,PlayerCar.y-stop.busY);if(dist<48&&carKmh()<4){m.stopHold=(m.stopHold||0)+dt;if(m.stopHold>=1.65){const ex=exchangeBusPassengers(m,stop,{final,player:true});spawnBusAlighters(PlayerCar,stop,ex.alight);m.stopHold=0;if(final)return missionComplete();m.busStopIndex=(m.busStopIndex||0)+1;const next=busMissionStop(m);setNavigationTarget(next.id,{mission:true,silent:true});SaveManager.log('mission','mission_state',{id:m.id,state:'progress',stage:'bus-route',stop:stop.id,next:next.id,board:ex.board,alight:ex.alight,onboard:m.passengers});SaveManager.save('bus-stop',{backup:false,silent:true});toast(`${stop.label.replace('קו 1 · ','')} · עלו ${ex.board}, ירדו ${ex.alight} · הבא: ${next.label.replace('קו 1 · ','')}`)}}else m.stopHold=0}
function updateRouteMission(dt,m,d){if(m.id==='M-A4-RUN'&&!a4LapGuard(dt,m))return;m.timeRemaining=Math.max(0,(m.timeRemaining??d.timeLimit)-dt);if(d.failOnCollision!==false&&(PlayerCar.collisions||0)>m.startCollisions)return missionFail('collision');if(m.timeRemaining<=0)return missionFail('timeout');const idx=clamp(m.routeIndex||0,0,d.stops.length-1),stopId=d.stops[idx],target=navPoiRegistry()[stopId];if(!target)return;if(PlayerProfile.mode!==(d.walk?'walk':'vehicle'))return;const actor=d.walk?PlayerPed:PlayerCar,dist=Math.hypot(actor.x-target.x,actor.y-target.y);if(dist>=(d.id==='M-A4-RUN'?12:d.walk?24:72)||(!d.walk&&carKmh()>=5))return;m.routeVisited=m.routeVisited||[];if(!m.routeVisited.includes(stopId))m.routeVisited.push(stopId);m.routeIndex=idx+1;SaveManager.log('mission','route_stop',{id:m.id,stop:stopId,index:idx+1,total:d.stops.length});if(m.routeIndex>=d.stops.length)return missionComplete();const next=d.stops[m.routeIndex];setNavigationTarget(next,{mission:true,silent:true});SaveManager.save('mission-route-stop',{backup:false,silent:true});toast('תחנה '+(idx+1)+'/'+d.stops.length+' הושלמה · הבא: '+(navPoiRegistry()[next]?.label||next))}
function updateMission(dt){const m=PlayerProfile.activeMission;if(!m)return;const d=MISSION_DEFS[m.id];if(!d){PlayerProfile.activeMission=null;clearNavigation({force:true,silent:true});return}if(d.type==='ground-training')return ew2UpdateJob(dt,m,d);if(d.type==='airport-pickup')return f2UpdatePickup(dt,m,d);if(d.type==='runway-observation')return f1UpdateMission(dt,m,d);if(d.type==='tower-view')return g77TvTick(dt);if(d.type==='shift')return actUpdate(dt,m,d);if(d.type==='bus')return updateBusDriverMission(dt,m,d);if(d.type==='forklift')return updateForkliftMission(dt,m,d);if(d.type==='route')return updateRouteMission(dt,m,d);m.timeRemaining=Math.max(0,(m.timeRemaining??d.timeLimit)-dt);if(d.failOnCollision!==false&&(PlayerCar.collisions||0)>m.startCollisions)return missionFail('collision');if(m.timeRemaining<=0)return missionFail('timeout');const target=navPoiRegistry()[m.stage==='pickup'?d.pickup:d.dropoff];if(!target)return;const dist=Math.hypot(PlayerCar.x-target.x,PlayerCar.y-target.y);if(PlayerProfile.mode==='vehicle'&&dist<72&&carKmh()<5){if(m.stage==='pickup'){m.stage='dropoff';m.payload=true;setNavigationTarget(d.dropoff,{mission:true,silent:true});SaveManager.log('mission','mission_state',{id:m.id,state:'progress',stage:'dropoff'});SaveManager.save('mission-pickup',{backup:false,silent:true});toast(d.pickupToast)}else missionComplete()}}
function resumeActiveMission(){const m=PlayerProfile.activeMission;if(!m){State.navigation=null;return}const d=MISSION_DEFS[m.id];if(!d){PlayerProfile.activeMission=null;State.navigation=null;return}if(d.vehicle&&PlayerCar.asset!==d.vehicle.asset){PlayerCar.asset=d.vehicle.asset;PlayerCar.ref=d.vehicle.ref;PlayerCar.state={};PlayerCar.speed=0;State.vehicleEcoOverride={fuel:100,damage:0,temporary:true}}if(d.type==='ground-training')return ew2ResumeJob(m,d);if(d.type==='airport-pickup')return f2ResumePickup(m);if(d.type==='runway-observation')return f1ResumeMission(m);if(d.type==='tower-view')return g77TvResume(m);if(d.type==='shift')return actResume(m,d);if(d.type==='bus')return setNavigationTarget(busMissionStop(m).id,{mission:true,silent:true});if(d.type==='route')return setNavigationTarget(d.stops[clamp(m.routeIndex||0,0,d.stops.length-1)],{mission:true,silent:true});if(d.type==='forklift'){PlayerProfile.mode='vehicle';const t=forkliftTask(m);return setNavigationTarget(m.stage==='forklift-drop'?t.drop.id:t.pickup.id,{mission:true,silent:true})}setNavigationTarget(m.stage==='dropoff'?d.dropoff:d.pickup,{mission:true,silent:true})}
function cancelActiveMission(){if(!PlayerProfile.activeMission)return;const m=PlayerProfile.activeMission,ret=m.returnVehicle,id=m.id,d=MISSION_DEFS[id];PlayerProfile.activeMission=null;clearNavigation({force:true,silent:true});if(d?.type==='ground-training')ew2RestoreJob(m);else if(d?.type==='forklift')restoreForkliftOperator(m);else if(!actRestore(m,d))applyVehicleSnapshot(ret,{keepPosition:true});SaveManager.log('mission','mission_state',{id,state:'cancelled'});SaveManager.save('mission-cancel',{backup:false,silent:true});toast('המשימה בוטלה')}

function ensureActivitySchema(){const c=PlayerProfile.career&&typeof PlayerProfile.career==='object'&&!Array.isArray(PlayerProfile.career)?PlayerProfile.career:(PlayerProfile.career={});c.v=1;for(const k of['xp','certs','stats','runs'])if(!c[k]||typeof c[k]!=='object'||Array.isArray(c[k]))c[k]={};for(const a of Object.keys(ACTIVITIES))if(!Number.isFinite(c.xp[a]))c.xp[a]=0;return c}
function actRankIndex(a){const xp=ensureActivitySchema().xp[a]||0,R=ACTIVITIES[a].ranks;let r=0;for(let i=1;i<R.length;i++){const q=R[i];if(q.soon||xp<q.xp||(q.cert&&!actHasCert(q.cert)))break;r=i}return r}
function actRankReq(q){return q.xp+' ניסיון'+(q.cert?' + '+ACT_CERTS[q.cert].name:'')}

function actRuns(a){const c=ensureActivitySchema();return a==='sports'?(c.runs['M-A4-RUN']||0)+Object.keys(A4_PRACTICES).reduce((n,k)=>n+(c.runs['A4-PRACTICE-'+k]||0),0):ACT_JOB_LIST.filter(j=>j.act===a).reduce((n,j)=>n+(c.runs[j.id]||0),0)}
function actJobStatus(d){const ri=actRankIndex(d.act);if(ri<d.rank){const q=ACTIVITIES[d.act].ranks[d.rank];return{ok:false,kind:'rank',why:'נדרשת דרגה: '+q.name+' ('+actRankReq(q)+')'}}if(d.needs&&!actHasCert(d.needs))return{ok:false,kind:'cert',why:'נדרשת '+ACT_CERTS[d.needs].name+' — מבחן המלגזה במחסן הנמל D5'};return{ok:true}}

const actBlocked=(x,y)=>staticPersonBlockedAt(x,y,PLAYER_PERSON_RADIUS)||parkedCarCollisionAt(x,y,PLAYER_PERSON_RADIUS);
function actStand(it){if(it.stand!==undefined)return it.stand;const g=18,fx=[.5,.25,.75],pts=[];for(const f of fx){pts.push([it.x+it.w*f,it.y-g],[it.x+it.w*f,it.y+it.h+g],[it.x-g,it.y+it.h*f],[it.x+it.w+g,it.y+it.h*f])}

function actRectDist(px,py,it){const dx=Math.max(it.x-px,0,px-(it.x+it.w)),dy=Math.max(it.y-py,0,py-(it.y+it.h));return Math.hypot(dx,dy)}

function actNearestItem(px,py,pool,reach){let best=null,bd=reach;for(const it of pool){const dd=actRectDist(px,py,it);if(dd<=bd){bd=dd;best=it}}return best}
function actPickTargets(d){const pool=[...actPool(d)],out=[];while(out.length<d.count&&pool.length)out.push(pool.splice(Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length),1)[0]);return out}
function actFocusItem(m,d){const A=m.act,left=A.targets.filter(i=>!A.scanned.includes(i));if(!left.length)return null;if(!left.includes(A.focus)){let best=null,bd=1e9;for(const id of left){const it=actItems()[id];if(!it)continue;const dd=Math.hypot(PlayerPed.x-it.cx,PlayerPed.y-it.cy);if(dd<bd){bd=dd;best=id}}A.focus=best}return actItems()[A.focus]}

 else{const t=actPickTargets(d);if(t.length<d.count)return toast('אין מספיק פריטים לסריקה כאן');PlayerProfile.activeMission={...base,stage:'shift-scan',act:{targets:t.map(i=>i.id),scanned:[],errors:0,strikes:0,focus:null}};actNavNext();toast(d.name+' התחילה · '+d.count+' פריטים לסריקה · קרא את השלט ולחץ F ליד הפריט')}

function actResume(m,d){if(d.engine==='fork'){PlayerProfile.mode='vehicle';const t=forkliftTask(m);return setNavigationTarget(m.stage==='forklift-drop'?t.drop.id:t.pickup.id,{mission:true,silent:true})}if(!m.act)m.act={targets:[],scanned:[],errors:0,strikes:0};if(m.act.targets.some(i=>!actItems()[i])){return missionFail('timeout')}actNavNext()}
function actUpdate(dt,m,d){if(d.engine==='fork')return updateForkliftMission(dt,m,d);m.timeRemaining=Math.max(0,(m.timeRemaining??d.timeLimit)-dt);if(m.timeRemaining<=0)return missionFail('timeout')}
function actInteract(){const m=actMission(),d=m&&MISSION_DEFS[m.id];if(!m||d.engine!=='scan')return false;if(PlayerProfile.mode!=='walk'){toast('במשמרת סריקה עובדים ברגל');return true}
 const A=m.act,pool=actPool(d),it=actNearestItem(PlayerPed.x,PlayerPed.y,pool,ACT_SCAN_REACH),left=A.targets.filter(i=>!A.scanned.includes(i));
 if(it){if(A.scanned.includes(it.id)){toast('כבר נסרק · '+actLtr(it.plate));return true}
  if(A.targets.includes(it.id)){A.scanned.push(it.id);A.focus=null;const n=A.targets.length-A.scanned.length;SaveManager.log('mission','act_scan',{id:m.id,item:it.id,left:n});SaveManager.save('act-scan',{backup:false,silent:true});actNavNext();toast(n?`✓ נסרק ${actLtr(it.plate)} · נותרו ${n}`:`✓ נסרק ${actLtr(it.plate)} · חזור אל ${actPoiXY(d.finish).label} ולחץ F לדו״ח`);return true}
  A.errors++;A.strikes++;SaveManager.log('mission','act_scan_error',{id:m.id,item:it.id,strikes:A.strikes});if(A.strikes>=ACT_STRIKES){missionFail('strikes');return true}toast(`✗ ${actLtr(it.plate)} אינו ברשימה · טעות ${A.strikes}/${ACT_STRIKES} · קנס ${money(ACT_ERR_FINE)}`);return true}
 const fin=actPoiXY(d.finish);if(!left.length&&Math.hypot(PlayerPed.x-fin.x,PlayerPed.y-fin.y)<=ACT_REPORT_REACH){missionComplete();return true}
 return false}
function actBonus(m,d){if(d?.type!=='shift')return 0;const rb=Math.round(d.reward*ACT_RANK_BONUS*actRankIndex(d.act)),errs=m.act?.errors||0,clean=d.engine==='scan'?errs===0:(PlayerCar.collisions||0)-(m.startCollisions||0)===0;return rb+(clean?ACT_FLAWLESS:0)-errs*ACT_ERR_FINE}
function actOnComplete(m,d,reward){const c=ensureActivitySchema(),spec=d.type==='shift'?{act:d.act,xp:d.xp,grants:d.grants}:d.career;if(!spec)return'';const before=actRankIndex(spec.act),repeat=(c.runs[d.id]||0)>0,gain=Math.round(spec.xp*(repeat?ACT_REPEAT_XP:1));c.xp[spec.act]=(c.xp[spec.act]||0)+gain;c.runs[d.id]=(c.runs[d.id]||0)+1;c.stats.shifts=(c.stats.shifts||0)+1;c.stats.earned=(c.stats.earned||0)+reward;if(d.type==='shift'&&m.act)c.stats.scans=(c.stats.scans||0)+m.act.scanned.length;
 let extra='';if(spec.grants&&!c.certs[spec.grants]){c.certs[spec.grants]={at:iso(),by:d.id};extra+=' · '+ACT_CERTS[spec.grants].name}const after=actRankIndex(spec.act);if(after>before)extra+=' · דרגה חדשה: '+ACTIVITIES[spec.act].ranks[after].name;return` · +${gain} XP${extra}`}
function actCompleteText(m,d,reward,suffix){const errs=m.act?.errors||0;return`${d.name} הושלמה · ${d.engine==='scan'?(errs?errs+' טעויות':'ללא טעויות'):'בלי התנגשויות מיותרות'} · קיבלת ${money(reward)}${suffix||''}`}

// ---------- QA ----------
function actFlood(box,start,blocked,step){const nx=Math.ceil(box.w/step)+1,ny=Math.ceil(box.h/step)+1,seen=new Uint8Array(nx*ny),cache=new Int8Array(nx*ny),at=(i,j)=>{const k=j*nx+i;if(cache[k]===0)cache[k]=blocked(box.x+i*step,box.y+j*step)?2:1;return cache[k]===1};
 let si=Math.round((start.x-box.x)/step),sj=Math.round((start.y-box.y)/step),found=false;for(let r=0;r<8&&!found;r++)for(let a=-r;a<=r&&!found;a++)for(let b=-r;b<=r&&!found;b++){if(Math.max(Math.abs(a),Math.abs(b))!==r)continue;const i=si+a,j=sj+b;if(i>=0&&j>=0&&i<nx&&j<ny&&at(i,j)){si=i;sj=j;found=true}}
 if(!found)return null;const q=[[si,sj]];seen[sj*nx+si]=1;while(q.length){const[i,j]=q.pop();for(const[di,dj]of[[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]]){const a=i+di,b=j+dj;if(a<0||b<0||a>=nx||b>=ny||seen[b*nx+a]||!at(a,b))continue;seen[b*nx+a]=1;q.push([a,b])}}
 return(x,y,tol=step*1.6)=>{for(const dy of[-tol,0,tol])for(const dx of[-tol,0,tol]){const i=Math.round((x+dx-box.x)/step),j=Math.round((y+dy-box.y)/step);if(i>=0&&j>=0&&i<nx&&j<ny&&seen[j*nx+i])return true}return false}}
const actFkBlocked=(x,y)=>{for(const h of[0,Math.PI/2]){const b=vehicleCollisionShape('LV-FK-01','Forklift',x,y,h);let hit=false;for(const p of[[x,y],[b.ax,b.ay],[b.bx,b.by]])if(blockedAt(p[0],p[1],b.radius)){hit=true;break}if(!hit)return false}return true};
function actAudit(){const issues=[],items=actItems(),plates=new Set();let scanItems=0;
 if(ACT_JOB_LIST.length!==10)issues.push('jobs:'+ACT_JOB_LIST.length);
 for(const d of ACT_JOB_LIST){if(!MISSION_DEFS[d.id]||MISSION_DEFS[d.id].type!=='shift')issues.push(d.id+':def');const s=actPoiXY(d.start),f=actPoiXY(d.finish);for(const p of[s,f]){if(!p.x||!inActiveRegion(p.x,p.y))issues.push(d.id+':poi:'+p.id);if(staticPersonBlockedAt(p.x,p.y,PLAYER_PERSON_RADIUS))issues.push(d.id+':poi-blocked:'+p.id)}
  if(d.rank>=ACTIVITIES[d.act].ranks.length)issues.push(d.id+':rank');if(d.engine==='fork'&&!d.needs&&!ACTIVITIES[d.act].ranks[d.rank].cert)issues.push(d.id+':fork-without-cert');
  if(d.engine==='scan'){const pool=actPool(d);scanItems+=pool.length;if(pool.length<d.count+1)issues.push(d.id+':pool:'+pool.length);for(const it of pool){if(!actStand(it))issues.push(d.id+':no-stand:'+it.id);if(!inActiveRegion(it.cx,it.cy))issues.push(it.id+':region')}}
  else{if(!d.tasks?.length)issues.push(d.id+':tasks');for(const t of d.tasks)for(const p of[t.pickup,t.drop]){if(actFkBlocked(p.x,p.y))issues.push(d.id+':fk-blocked:'+p.id);if(!inActiveRegion(p.x,p.y))issues.push(p.id+':region')}}}
 if(actFkBlocked(ACT_FK_HOME.x,ACT_FK_HOME.y))issues.push('fk-home-blocked');
 for(const it of Object.values(items)){const k=it.plate;if(it.group.startsWith('D4')||it.group.startsWith('C6')||it.group.startsWith('E6')){if(plates.has(k))issues.push('plate-dup:'+k);plates.add(k)}}
 for(const a of Object.values(ACTIVITIES)){let prev=-1;for(const r of a.ranks){if(r.xp<=prev)issues.push(a.id+':ranks-order');prev=r.xp}const live=a.ranks.filter(r=>!r.soon),top=live[live.length-1].xp,avail=ACT_JOB_LIST.filter(j=>j.act===a.id).reduce((n,j)=>n+j.xp,0)+(a.id==='warehouse'?120:a.id==='sports'?Object.values(A4_PRACTICES).reduce((n,q)=>n+q.xp,0)+MISSION_DEFS['M-A4-RUN'].career.xp:0);const repeatCareer=Object.values(MISSION_DEFS).some(d=>d.repeatable===true&&d.career?.act===a.id&&d.career.xp>0&&ACT_REPEAT_XP>0);if(avail<top&&!repeatCareer)issues.push(a.id+':live-top-rank-unreachable:'+avail+'<'+top);for(const j of ACT_JOB_LIST.filter(j=>j.act===a.id))if(a.ranks[j.rank].soon)issues.push(j.id+':needs-locked-rank')}
 const needFork=ACT_JOB_LIST.filter(j=>j.needs==='CERT-FORK').every(j=>MISSION_DEFS['M-D5-FK-01']?.career?.grants==='CERT-FORK'&&j.rank>=0);if(!needFork)issues.push('fork-cert-chain');
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:issues.slice(0,14),issueCount:issues.length,jobs:ACT_JOB_LIST.length,scanItems,items:Object.keys(items).length,apps:PHONE_APPS.length}}
// heavy: flood-fills the real map on foot (and with the forklift) from every start desk; the harness runs it, not the page load
function actReachAudit(step=8){const issues=[],unreachable={},items=actItems();
 for(const d of ACT_JOB_LIST){const s=actPoiXY(d.start),f=actPoiXY(d.finish);
  if(d.engine==='scan'){const all=Object.values(items).filter(it=>d.pool.includes(it.group)&&!ACT_EXCLUDE.has(it.id)&&actStand(it)),xs=[s.x,f.x,...all.map(i=>i.cx)],ys=[s.y,f.y,...all.map(i=>i.cy)],box={x:Math.min(...xs)-160,y:Math.min(...ys)-160};box.w=Math.max(...xs)+160-box.x;box.h=Math.max(...ys)+160-box.y;
   const reach=actFlood(box,s,actBlocked,step);if(!reach){issues.push(d.id+':start-sealed');continue}if(!reach(f.x,f.y,20))issues.push(d.id+':finish-unreachable');
   for(const it of all){const st=actStand(it);if(!reach(st.x,st.y,6)){(unreachable[d.id]=unreachable[d.id]||[]).push(it.id)}}}
  else{const pts=[d.home||ACT_FK_HOME,...d.tasks.flatMap(t=>[t.pickup,t.drop])],box={x:Math.min(...pts.map(p=>p.x))-140,y:Math.min(...pts.map(p=>p.y))-140};box.w=Math.max(...pts.map(p=>p.x))+140-box.x;box.h=Math.max(...pts.map(p=>p.y))+140-box.y;const reach=actFlood(box,d.home||ACT_FK_HOME,actFkBlocked,10);if(!reach){issues.push(d.id+':forklift-sealed');continue}for(const t of d.tasks)for(const p of[t.pickup,t.drop])if(!reach(p.x,p.y,6))issues.push(d.id+':fk-unreachable:'+p.id)}}
 const bad=Object.entries(unreachable);for(const[k,v]of bad)issues.push(k+':items-unreachable:'+v.length);const distinct=new Set(ACT_JOB_LIST.filter(j=>j.engine==='scan').flatMap(j=>actPool(j).map(i=>i.id))).size,pallets=ACT_JOB_LIST.filter(j=>j.engine==='fork').reduce((n,j)=>n+j.tasks.length*2,0);return{ok:!issues.length,issues:issues.slice(0,20),unreachable,excluded:[...ACT_EXCLUDE],scanItemsDistinct:distinct,forkSpots:pallets}}
window.__TC_ACT_REACH=actReachAudit;window.__TC_ACT=()=>({jobs:ACT_JOB_LIST.length,career:cloneJson(ensureActivitySchema()),audit:actAudit()});


// ===== v1.91 RAIL LINE ======================================================================================================================
// East line on a bridge over the sea (GATE-75: straight east along y 5120, the quay-siding line, out of the world), a branch bridge to the island
// in G8, wide-radius junctions (GATE-75 · RAIL-03: R 400 at the quay, R 400 at the east link, R 350 to the island) and the live freight service.
// Trains are PURE FUNCTIONS OF THE CLOCK, like the quay cycle: nothing is saved and nothing can desynchronise.
//   FRT-1  (GATE-75: loco + W1-W4) port quay -> east bridge -> island (G8) -> back over the bridge -> R400 link to main B -> turn-back on main B
//          in E5 (the whole train north of the port crossover) -> port crossover onto main A -> R400 arc -> quay. Reverses at each end; the
//          E4 run is suspended with Rail–Air (GATE-76 brings the airport run back).
//   FRT-2  visitor from beyond the world: comes in over the bridge from the east edge, stops at the border siding, goes back out.
// Geometry rules: the bridges carry rails only (no road vehicles); beyond x 8400 the line simply leaves the map (the bridge is drawn to x 8760,
// trains fade out there); the line north stops at y 2590 in E4 (the E3 station and the airport terminal are not connected yet).

const RL_DECK_W=66;
const RL_COAST_X=6000;
// ---- 1. helpers: segment slices, paths, poses ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function rlSlice(g,a,b){
 const lo=Math.min(a,b),hi=Math.max(a,b),at=s=>{const p=railPointAt(g.id,s);return[p.x,p.y]};
 const out=[at(lo)];for(let i=1;i<g.pts.length-1;i++)if(g.cum[i]>lo+.01&&g.cum[i]<hi-.01)out.push(g.pts[i]);out.push(at(hi));
 return a<=b?out:out.reverse()}
function rlPathBuild(legs){
 const pts=[];
 for(const [id,a,b] of legs){
  const g=RAIL_SEG_BY_ID[id];if(!g)throw new Error('no seg '+id);
  const A=a==='S'?0:a==='E'?g.len:a,B=b==='S'?0:b==='E'?g.len:b;
  const sl=rlSlice(g,A,B);
  if(pts.length&&Math.hypot(sl[0][0]-pts[pts.length-1][0],sl[0][1]-pts[pts.length-1][1])>.8)throw new Error('gap before '+id+' at '+sl[0].map(v=>v.toFixed(1)));
  for(const p of sl){const l=pts[pts.length-1];if(l&&Math.hypot(p[0]-l[0],p[1]-l[1])<.05)continue;pts.push(p)}
 }
 const cum=[0];for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++)cum.push(cum[i-1]+Math.hypot(pts[i][0]-pts[i-1][0],pts[i][1]-pts[i-1][1]));
 return{pts,cum,len:cum[cum.length-1]}}
function rlAt(P,u){
 u=Math.max(0,Math.min(P.len,u));let lo=1,hi=P.pts.length-1;
 while(lo<hi){const m=(lo+hi)>>1;if(P.cum[m]<u)lo=m+1;else hi=m}
 const a=P.pts[lo-1],b=P.pts[lo],l=P.cum[lo]-P.cum[lo-1]||1,t=(u-P.cum[lo-1])/l;
 return{x:a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*t,y:a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*t,h:Math.atan2(b[1]-a[1],b[0]-a[0])}}
// distance covered after t seconds on a run of length d (accelerate, cruise, brake)
function rlProfile(d,v,a,t){
 const da=v*v/(2*a);
 if(t<=0)return 0;
 if(d<=2*da){const tp=Math.sqrt(d/a),T=2*tp;if(t>=T)return d;if(t<tp)return .5*a*t*t;const r=T-t;return d-.5*a*r*r}
 const ta=v/a,tc=(d-2*da)/v,T=2*ta+tc;
 if(t>=T)return d;if(t<ta)return .5*a*t*t;if(t<ta+tc)return da+v*(t-ta);const r=T-t;return d-.5*a*r*r}
function rlRunTime(d,v,a){const da=v*v/(2*a);return d<=2*da?2*Math.sqrt(d/a):2*v/a+(d-2*da)/v}
